title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十: 世祖七
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十: 世祖七 Volume 10 Annals 10: Shizu 7

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月辛卯，阿老瓦丁將兵戍斡端，給米三千石、鈔三十錠。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, spring, first month, on xinmao day, Alawadin led troops to garrison Otgon and was granted three thousand shi of grain and thirty ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on the xinmao day of the first month of spring, Alawadin led troops to garrison Otgon and received three thousand shi of grain and thirty ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 以千戶鄭鄩有戰功，升萬戶，佩虎符。

translations.literal: Because qianhu Zheng E had merit in battle, he was promoted to wanhu and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Because qianhu Zheng E had won distinction in battle, he was promoted to wanhu and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，西京饑，發粟一萬石賑之，仍諭阿合馬廣貯積，以備闕乏。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Western Capital suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve it, and Ahmad was instructed to store up widely against shortages.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day famine struck the Western Capital; ten thousand shi of grain were issued for relief, and Ahmad was told to build up reserves against future shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 順德府總管張文煥、太原府達魯花赤太不花，以按察司發其奸贓，遣人詣省自首，反以罪誣按察司。

translations.literal: Shunde Prefecture prefect Zhang Wenhuan and Taiyuan Prefecture darughachi Tabuqa, after the surveillance commission exposed their corruption, sent men to the secretariat to confess, yet falsely charged the surveillance commission with crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Shunde Prefecture prefect Zhang Wenhuan and Taiyuan Prefecture darughachi Tabuqa, once the surveillance commission had exposed their corruption, sent men to the secretariat to confess, then tried to shift the blame onto the surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣奏：「按察司設果有罪，不應因事而告，宜待文煥等事決，方聽其訴。

translations.literal: Censorate officials memorialized: "If the surveillance commission truly has guilt, they should not lodge charges because of this affair; Zhang Wenhuan's case should be decided first, and only then should their suit be heard.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials memorialized, "If the surveillance commission is truly guilty, they ought not bring charges over this matter; Zhang Wenhuan's case should be decided first, and only then should their complaint be heard.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，收括闌遺官也先、闊闊帶等坐易官馬、闌遺人畜，免其罪，以諸路州縣管民官兼領其事。

translations.literal: On jihai day Yehsien, Koke Temür, and other officials who had rounded up stray property were pardoned for exchanging official horses and stray livestock; circuit, prefecture, and county civilian administrators were ordered jointly to take charge of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Yehsien, Koke Temür, and other officials charged with rounding up stray property were pardoned for trading official horses and stray livestock; civilian administrators in the circuits, prefectures, and counties were ordered to take joint charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 官吏隱匿及擅易馬匹、私配婦人者，沒其家。

translations.literal: Officials who concealed property, exchanged horses without authorization, or privately assigned women had their households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who hid property, exchanged horses without authorization, or privately assigned women would have their households confiscated.

sentences.zh: 禁官吏軍民賣所娶江南良家子女及為娼者，賣、買者兩罪之，官沒其直，人復為良。

translations.literal: Sale by officials, soldiers, and civilians of Jiangnan commoners' children they had taken as wives, or sale as prostitutes, was forbidden; buyers and sellers were both punished, the price confiscated by the state, and the persons restored to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, soldiers, and civilians were forbidden to sell Jiangnan commoners' children they had taken as wives or to sell them as prostitutes; buyers and sellers were both punished, the price was confiscated, and the persons were restored to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 賜湖州長興縣金沙泉名為瑞應泉。

translations.literal: The Jinsha Spring in Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, was given the name Auspicious Response Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Jinsha Spring in Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, was renamed Auspicious Response Spring.

sentences.zh: 金沙泉不常出，唐時用此水造紫筍茶進貢，有司具牲幣祭之，始得水，事訖輒涸。

translations.literal: Jinsha Spring did not flow regularly; in Tang times this water was used to make Purple Bud tea for tribute; when officials prepared sacrificial victims and silks and offered sacrifice, water would appear, then dry up again when the rite ended.
translations.idiomatic: Jinsha Spring did not flow steadily; in Tang times its water was used to make Purple Bud tea for tribute, and when officials prepared victims and silks and offered sacrifice, water would appear, only to dry up again once the rite was done.

sentences.zh: 宋末屢加浚治，泉迄不出。

translations.literal: At the end of Song it was repeatedly dredged and repaired, yet the spring still would not flow.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Song it was dredged and repaired again and again, but the spring still would not flow.

sentences.zh: 至是中書省遣官致祭，一夕水溢，可溉田千畝。

translations.literal: At this time the Central Secretariat dispatched officials to offer sacrifice; overnight the water overflowed, sufficient to irrigate a thousand mu of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Central Secretariat sent officials to offer sacrifice, and overnight the water overflowed, enough to irrigate a thousand mu of fields.

sentences.zh: 安撫司以事聞，故賜今名。

translations.literal: The pacification commission reported the matter, and for this reason the present name was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commission reported what had happened, and for that reason the present name was granted.

sentences.zh: 封磁州神崔府君為齊聖廣佑王。

translations.literal: The god Lord Cui of Cizhou Prefecture was enfeoffed as King Qisheng of Broad Aid.
translations.idiomatic: The god Lord Cui of Cizhou Prefecture was enfeoffed as King Qisheng of Broad Aid.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，弛女直、水達達酒禁。

translations.literal: On renyin day the wine prohibition was lifted for Jurchen and Suiban peoples.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the wine ban was lifted for the Jurchen and Suiban peoples.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安西王相府言：「萬戶禿滿答兒、郝劄剌不花等攻克瀘州，斬其主將王世昌、李都統。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Anxi Prince's chancellor's office reported: "Wanhu Tuman Dar and Hao Jalabuhua and others captured Luzhou and beheaded its commanders Wang Shichang and Commander Li.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Anxi Prince's chancellor's office reported that wanhu Tuman Dar and Hao Jalabuhua and others had taken Luzhou and beheaded its commanders Wang Shichang and Commander Li.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，從阿合馬請，自今御史臺非白於省，毋擅召倉庫吏，亦毋究錢谷數，及集議中書不至者罪之。

translations.literal: " On wushen day, granting Ahmad's request, from now on the Censorate was not to summon warehouse clerks without informing the Secretariat, nor investigate cash and grain accounts; those who failed to attend joint deliberations at the Central Secretariat would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, granting Ahmad's request, the Censorate was forbidden from now on to summon warehouse clerks without notifying the Secretariat or to investigate cash and grain accounts; those absent from joint deliberations at the Central Secretariat would be punished.

sentences.zh: 授宋福王趙與芮金紫光祿大夫、檢校大司農、平原郡公。

translations.literal: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui was appointed honorary golden-bright grand master of the palace, titular minister of grand granaries, and Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui was made honorary golden-bright grand master of the palace, titular minister of grand granaries, and Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，東川副都元帥張德潤大敗涪州兵，斬州將王明及其子忠訓、總轄韓文廣、張遇春。

translations.literal: On gengxu day East Sichuan deputy commander-in-chief Zhang Derun greatly defeated Fuzhou troops, beheading prefectural commander Wang Ming and his son Zhongxun, zongguan Han Wenguang, and Zhang Yuchun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day East Sichuan deputy commander-in-chief Zhang Derun routed the troops of Fuzhou, beheading prefectural commander Wang Ming and his son Zhongxun, zongguan Han Wenguang, and Zhang Yuchun.

sentences.zh: 詔軍官不能撫治軍士及役擾致逃亡者，沒其家貲之半。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that military officers who could not keep discipline among their soldiers, or whose corvée abuses drove men to desert, would have half their household goods confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that officers who failed to keep their soldiers in order, or whose corvée abuses drove men to desert, would forfeit half their household goods.

sentences.zh: 以阿你哥為大司徒，兼領將作院。

translations.literal: Anige was made grand steward and also placed in charge of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.
translations.idiomatic: Anige was made grand steward and placed in charge of the Directorate of Palace Buildings as well.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，祀先農。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuwu day, sacrifice was offered to the First Farmer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu day, sacrifice was offered to the First Farmer.

sentences.zh: 蒙古胄子代耕籍田。

translations.literal: Mongol princely sons performed the plowing rite in the ceremonial field in their stead.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol princely sons performed the ceremonial plowing in their stead.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，咸淳府等郡及大良平民戶饑，以鈔千錠賑之。

translations.literal: On guihai day Xianchun Prefecture and other commanderies and the common households of Daliang suffered famine; one thousand ingots of paper currency were issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day famine struck Xianchun Prefecture and other commanderies and the common households of Daliang; one thousand ingots of paper currency were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 命平章政事阿塔海、阿裏選擇江南廉能之官，去其冗員與不勝任者。

translations.literal: Grand councillors Atahai and Ari were ordered to select capable and honest officials in Jiangnan and remove redundant and incompetent ones.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillors Atahai and Ari were ordered to choose capable and honest officials in Jiangnan and remove redundant and unfit ones.

sentences.zh: 復立河中府萬泉縣。

translations.literal: Wanquan County in Hezhong Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Wanquan County in Hezhong Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以川蜀地多嵐瘴，弛酒禁。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, because Sichuan lands were much afflicted by miasma, the wine prohibition was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the wine ban was lifted in Sichuan, where miasma was widespread.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熒惑犯天街。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Mars transited Celestial Street.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Mars transited Celestial Street.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，征別十八里軍士，免其徭役。

translations.literal: On gengchen day soldiers of Bieshibali called up for campaign were exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day soldiers of Bieshibali called up for campaign were exempted from corvée.

sentences.zh: 壬午，參知政事、福建路宣慰使唆都率師攻潮州，破之。

translations.literal: On renwu day associate administrator and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Sudu led troops to attack Chaozhou and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day associate administrator and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Sudu led troops against Chaozhou and captured it.

sentences.zh: 置太史院，命太子贊善王恂掌院事，工部郎中郭守敬副之，集賢大學士兼國子祭酒許衡領焉。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was established; crown prince tutor Wang Xun was ordered to direct it, Works Ministry langzhong Guo Shoujing to assist him, and Academician-Grand Councillor and concurrent National University chancellor Xu Heng to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was established; crown prince tutor Wang Xun was put in charge, Works Ministry langzhong Guo Shoujing was made his deputy, and Academician-Grand Councillor and concurrent National University chancellor Xu Heng was placed over the whole office.

sentences.zh: 改華亭縣為松江府。

translations.literal: Huating County was changed to Songjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huating County was upgraded to Songjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事夏貴、範文虎、陳巖並為中書左丞，黃州路宣慰使唐兀帶、史弼並參知政事。

translations.literal: Associate administrators Xia Gui, Fan Wenhu, and Chen Yan were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Huangzhou Circuit pacification commissioner Tangudai and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrators Xia Gui, Fan Wenhu, and Chen Yan were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat, and Huangzhou Circuit pacification commissioner Tangudai and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，詔蒙古帶、唆都、蒲壽庚行中書省事於福州，鎮撫瀕海諸郡。

translations.literal: Third month, on yiyou day, an edict ordered Mangudai, Sudu, and Pu Shougeng to conduct branch secretariat affairs at Fuzhou and pacify the coastal commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou day, an edict ordered Mangudai, Sudu, and Pu Shougeng to run branch secretariat affairs at Fuzhou and pacify the coastal commanderies.

sentences.zh: 以沿海經略副使合剌帶領舟師南征，升經略使兼左副都元帥，佩虎符。

translations.literal: Coastal frontier deputy commissioner Heladai was placed in command of the fleet for the southern campaign; he was promoted to frontier commissioner and concurrent left deputy commander-in-chief and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal frontier deputy commissioner Heladai was put in command of the fleet for the southern campaign, promoted to frontier commissioner and concurrent left deputy commander-in-chief, and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太陰犯太白。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon invaded Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon invaded Venus.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the moon invaded Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon invaded Mars.

sentences.zh: 己丑，行中書省請考核行御史臺文卷，不從。

translations.literal: On jichou day the branch secretariat requested to audit the mobile censorate's documents; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the branch secretariat asked to audit the mobile censorate's documents; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 甲午，西川行樞密院招降西蜀、重慶等處，得府三、州六、軍一、監一、縣二十、柵四十、蠻夷一。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Western Shu, Chongqing, and other places, yielding three prefectures, six subprefectures, one army, one directorate, twenty counties, forty stockades, and one barbarian domain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Western Shu, Chongqing, and other places, yielding three prefectures, six subprefectures, one army, one directorate, twenty counties, forty stockades, and one barbarian domain.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宋廣王昺遣倪堅以表來上，令俟命大都。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing sent Ni Jian with a memorial to court and ordered him to await orders at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Song Prince Guang Zhao Bing sent Ni Jian with a memorial to court and told him to await orders at the capital.

sentences.zh: 命揚州行省選鐵木兒不花所部兵助隆興進討。

translations.literal: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to select troops from Temür Buqa's command to assist the advance against Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to choose troops from Temür Buqa's command to help the advance against Longxing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命塔海毀夔府城壁。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Tachai was ordered to destroy the walls of Kuizhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Tachai was ordered to tear down the walls of Kuizhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，劉宗純據德慶府，梧州萬戶朱國寶攻之，焚其寨柵，遂拔德慶。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Liu Zongchun held Deqing Prefecture; Wuzhou wanhu Zhu Guobao attacked him, burned his stockades and palisades, and then took Deqing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Liu Zongchun held Deqing Prefecture; Wuzhou wanhu Zhu Guobao attacked him, burned his stockades and palisades, and captured Deqing.

sentences.zh: 詔中書左丞呂文煥遣官招宋生、熟券軍，堪為軍者，月給錢糧；

translations.literal: An edict ordered left associate Lü Wenhuan to dispatch officials to recruit Song raw and seasoned ticket soldiers; those fit for service were to receive monthly pay and rations;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered left associate Lü Wenhuan to send officials to recruit raw and seasoned ticket soldiers of Song; those fit for service were to receive monthly pay and rations;

sentences.zh: 不堪者，給牛屯田。

translations.literal: those unfit were to be given oxen for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: those unfit were to be given oxen for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 庚子，漢軍都元帥李庭自願將兵擊張世傑，從之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Han army commander-in-chief Li Ting volunteered to lead troops against Zhang Shijie; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Han army commander-in-chief Li Ting volunteered to lead troops against Zhang Shijie, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 西川行樞密院招宜勝、土恢等城及石榴寨，相繼來降。

translations.literal: The Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Yisheng, Tuhui, and other cities and Shiliu Stockade, which submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan mobile privy council won over Yisheng, Tuhui, and other cities and Shiliu Stockade, which surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以諸路歲比不登，免今年田租、絲銀。

translations.literal: On renyin day, because harvests had failed year after year in the circuits, this year's field rent and silk tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, because harvests had failed year after year across the circuits, this year's field rent and silk tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，都元帥楊文安遣兵攻克紹慶，執其郡守鮮龍，命斬之。

translations.literal: On guimao day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an dispatched troops to capture Shaoqing, seized its prefect Xian Long, and ordered him beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an sent troops to take Shaoqing, seized its prefect Xian Long, and had him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廣南西道宣慰司遣管軍總管崔永、千戶劉潭、王德用招降雷、化、高三州，即以永等鎮守之。

translations.literal: On yisi day the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission dispatched garrison commander Cui Yong, qianhu Liu Tan, and Wang Deyong to win over Lei, Hua, and Gao prefectures, and Yong and the others were left to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Guangnan West Circuit pacification commission sent garrison commander Cui Yong, qianhu Liu Tan, and Wang Deyong to win over Lei, Hua, and Gao prefectures, and Yong and his party were left to garrison them.

sentences.zh: 宋張世傑、蘇劉義挾廣王昺奔碙洲。

translations.literal: Song's Zhang Shijie and Su Liuyi took Prince Guang Zhao Bing and fled to Yaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song's Zhang Shijie and Su Liuyi took Prince Guang Zhao Bing and fled to Yaizhou.

sentences.zh: 參知政事密立忽辛、張守智並行大司農司事。

translations.literal: Associate administrators Milhuxin and Zhang Shouzhi were both ordered to conduct Ministry of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrators Milhuxin and Zhang Shouzhi were both placed in charge of Ministry of Revenue affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，命元帥劉國傑將萬人北征，賜將士鈔二萬六百七十一錠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, commander Liu Guojie was ordered to lead ten thousand men on a northern campaign, and the officers and soldiers were granted twenty thousand six hundred seventy-one ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the yimao day of the fourth month, commander Liu Guojie was ordered to lead ten thousand men north, and the officers and soldiers received 20,671 ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 修會川縣盤古王祠，祀之。

translations.literal: The Temple of King Pangu in Huichuan County was repaired and sacrifice was offered there.
translations.idiomatic: The Temple of King Pangu in Huichuan County was repaired and sacrifice was offered there.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以雲南境土曠遠，未降者多，簽軍萬人進討。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict ordered that because Yunnan's territory was vast and many places had not yet submitted, ten thousand men were to be levied for a punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered ten thousand men levied for a punitive campaign, because Yunnan's territory was vast and many places had not yet submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以江南土寇竊發，人心未安，命行中書省左丞夏貴等，分道撫治軍民，檢核錢谷；

translations.literal: On wuwu day, because bandits had broken out in Jiangnan and hearts were still unsettled, left associate Xia Gui and others of the branch secretariat were ordered to pacify soldiers and civilians by separate routes and audit cash and grain;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, because bandits had broken out in Jiangnan and the people were still unsettled, branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui and others were ordered to pacify soldiers and civilians along separate routes and audit cash and grain;

sentences.zh: 察郡縣被旱災甚者、吏廉能者，舉以聞；

translations.literal: to investigate commanderies and counties severely afflicted by drought and officials who were honest and capable, and report them;
translations.idiomatic: to look into commanderies and counties hard hit by drought and officials who were honest and capable, and report them;

sentences.zh: 其貪殘不勝任者，劾罷之。

translations.literal: and to impeach and dismiss those who were greedy, cruel, and unfit for office.
translations.idiomatic: and to impeach and remove those who were greedy, cruel, and unfit for office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命不花留鎮西川，汪惟正率獲功蒙古、漢軍官及降臣入覲，大都巡軍之戍西川者遣還。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Buqa was ordered to remain and garrison Western Sichuan; Wang Weizheng led meritorious Mongol and Han army officers and surrendered officials to audience; the capital patrol troops garrisoning Western Sichuan were sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Buqa was ordered to remain and garrison Western Sichuan; Wang Weizheng led meritorious Mongol and Han army officers and surrendered officials to audience; the capital patrol troops garrisoning Western Sichuan were sent home.

sentences.zh: 立雲南、湖南二轉運司。

translations.literal: Transport commissions were established in Yunnan and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established in Yunnan and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以時雨沾足，稍弛酒禁，民之衰疾飲藥者，官為醞釀量給之。

translations.literal: Because timely rain had fallen in full measure, the wine prohibition was slightly relaxed; for common people weakened by age or illness who drank medicine, the state was to brew and measure out supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Because the timely rains had been ample, the wine ban was partly relaxed; for common people weakened by age or illness who needed wine for medicine, the state would brew and ration supplies.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置光祿寺，以同知宣徽院事禿剌鐵木兒為光祿卿。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrificial Victuals was established, with concurrent vice-director of the Imperial Household Directorate Tula Temür as director of imperial sacrificial victuals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrificial Victuals was established, with concurrent vice-director of the Imperial Household Directorate Tula Temür as its director.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on dismissed officials would step down one rank: grand councillors to pacification commissioners, pacification commissioners to circuit officials, and circuit officials to prefectural officials.

translations.idiomatic: Huai and Zhe salt revenues were placed directly under the branch secretariat, and pacification commissioners were not to intervene.

translations.literal: The Northern Capital branch secretariat was changed to a pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Capital branch secretariat was converted to a pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 追江南工匠官虎符。

translations.literal: Tiger tallies held by Jiangnan artisan officials were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger tallies held by Jiangnan artisan officials were recalled.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, when officials of every rank committed crimes, those appointed by rescript were reported to the throne; those appointed by edict were handled by the mobile censorate; those appointed by secretariat dispatch were tried by the surveillance commission.

translations.idiomatic: For pacification commission officials guilty of wickedness, violation, or irregular documents and dossiers, the circuit surveillance commission was to review and correct them.

translations.idiomatic: Cases were grouped and submitted awaiting command.

translations.idiomatic: For public business from the branch secretariat downward, small matters were limited to seven days, medium matters to fifteen days, and great matters to thirty days.

translations.idiomatic: Crack troops from Jiangnan were chosen for the Palace Guard.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wumeng Circuit was placed under the Yunnan branch secretariat; an edict also instructed Wumeng Circuit prefect Amu to establish relay stations and repair roads, and all affairs were to be directed by branch secretariat grand councillor Sayid Ajall.

translations.idiomatic: Water relay stations were established in Sichuan from Xuzhou to Jingnan Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Jiangdong Circuit surveillance commissioner Abaqa sought gold and silver vessels and dwelling houses with women and children from Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan, failed to get them, and then falsely charged him with privately hiding arms.

sentences.zh: 詔行臺大夫相威詰之，事白，免阿八赤官。

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered mobile censorate chief Xiangwei to investigate; when the truth came out, Abaqa was dismissed from office.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Zhang Liusun was appointed by decree chief prelate of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.

sentences.zh: 賜拱衛司官及其所部四百五十人鈔二千六十錠。

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao day, the Western Tibet Li Tang city was upgraded to Li Tang Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered that Bo'erchi, Darqchi, and officials of the grain and coin offices were not to receive tallies; those already granted were to be recalled.

translations.idiomatic: On renxu day surrendered officials of Luzhou including Xue Wang and others received paper currency in varying amounts.

translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because the thirteen frontier passes in Jiangnan were overstaffed, one honest and capable military-civilian official was chosen to take charge of each.

translations.idiomatic: Jinan Prefecture was promoted to Jinan Circuit, and Xiliang Prefecture was demoted to Xiliang subprefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day a He-di Purchase and Relief Office was established in Ganzhou to supply army rations and relieve the poor.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered the elimination of redundant offices in Jiangnan.

translations.idiomatic: Shitatalun and Tangudai, who had been abruptly promoted to the executive, and Mangudai, who held darughachi of Wuwei Army while also remotely supervising Huang Prefecture pacification commissioner — all were dismissed.

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor addressed Angir: "A chancellor who understands Heaven's Way, observes geography, and exhausts human affairs — only one who combines all three is fit for the office.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day 1,277 ingots of paper currency were granted to needy troops under Prince Ai-yachi's Jiandu garrison.

sentences.zh: 行御史臺增設監察御史四員。

translations.literal: The mobile Censorate added four investigating censor positions.
translations.idiomatic: The mobile Censorate added four investigating censor positions.

sentences.zh: 江南湖北道、嶺南廣西道、福建廣東道並增設提刑按察司。

translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan Hubei Route, Lingnan Guangxi Route, and Fujian Guangdong Route each added chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改江南諸路總管府為散府者七、為州者一，散府為州者二。

translations.literal: On yiyou day among Jiangnan route general administrations, seven were changed to direct prefectures and one to a prefecture; two direct prefectures were changed to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day among Jiangnan route general administrations, seven were changed to direct prefectures and one to a prefecture; two direct prefectures were changed to prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because Jiangnan affairs were numerous and branch secretariat officials included none versed in letters, which might harm administration, Cui Bin was separately ordered to the Yangzhou branch secretariat and Zhang Shouzhi to the Tanzhou branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔虎符舊用畏吾字，今易以國字。

translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed that tiger tallies formerly cast in Uighur script should now be changed to the national script.

translations.literal: On guisi day troops returning from garrison after Tachai's campaign in Kui, together with Yangzhou and Jiangxi river forces, were all placed under naval wanhu Zhang Rongshi to guard the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day troops returning from garrison after Tachai's campaign in Kui, together with Yangzhou and Jiangxi river forces, were all placed under naval wanhu Zhang Rongshi to guard the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以右丞塔出、左丞呂師夔、參知政事賈居貞行中書省事於贛州，福建、江西、廣東皆隸焉。

translations.literal: On bingshen day right associate Tachu, left associate Lü Shi'ao, and associate administrator Jia Juzhen were placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Ganzhou; Fujian, Jiangxi, and Guangdong were all placed under them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day right associate Tachu, left associate Lü Shi'ao, and associate administrator Jia Juzhen were placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Ganzhou; Fujian, Jiangxi, and Guangdong were all placed under them.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜江西軍與張世傑力戰者三十人，各銀五十兩。

translations.literal: On dingyou day thirty men of the Jiangxi army who had fought hard against Zhang Shijie were each granted fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day thirty men of the Jiangxi army who had fought hard against Zhang Shijie were each granted fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 以江西參知政事李恒為都元帥，將蒙古、漢軍征廣。

translations.literal: Jiangxi associate administrator Li Heng was made chief commander-in-chief to lead Mongol and Han troops against Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi associate administrator Li Heng was made chief commander-in-chief to lead Mongol and Han troops against Guang.

sentences.zh: 命揚州行中書省分軍三千付李恒。

translations.literal: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to detach three thousand troops for Li Heng.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou branch secretariat was ordered to detach three thousand troops for Li Heng.

sentences.zh: 復上都守城軍二千人為民。

translations.literal: Two thousand Shangdu garrison troops were restored to civilian status.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand Shangdu garrison troops were restored to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改鑄高麗王王愖駙馬印。

translations.literal: On renyin day the consort prince seal of Goryeo King Wang Zhen was recast.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the consort prince seal of Goryeo King Wang Zhen was recast.

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Kaiyuan pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, Taicang to the Imperial Granary, the Zicheng Storehouse to the Directorate of Imperial Use, and the hides bureau was absorbed into the general administration.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Kaiyuan pacification commission was changed to a pacification commission, Taicang to the Imperial Granary, the Zicheng Storehouse to the Directorate of Imperial Use, and the hides bureau was absorbed into the general administration.

sentences.zh: 定江南俸祿職田。

translations.literal: Salaries and official fields for Jiangnan were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Salaries and official fields for Jiangnan were fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，濮州蝗。

translations.literal: On wushen day locusts struck Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day locusts struck Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁使人經行納憐驛。

translations.literal: On jiyou day envoys were forbidden to pass through Naling Post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day envoys were forbidden to pass through Naling Post.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，改京兆府為安西府。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Jingzhao Prefecture was changed to Anxi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jingzhao Prefecture was changed to Anxi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔江南、浙西等處毋非理征科擾民。

translations.literal: An edict directed that Jiangnan, western Zhe, and other regions must not levy taxes unreasonably and disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that Jiangnan, western Zhe, and other regions must not levy taxes unreasonably and disturb the people.

sentences.zh: 建漢祖天師正一祠於京城。

translations.literal: A temple to the Orthodox Unity Celestial Master of Han was built in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A temple to the Orthodox Unity Celestial Master of Han was built in the capital.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事李恒為蒙古、漢軍都元帥，忙古帶為福建路宣慰使，張榮實、張鼎並為湖北道宣慰使，也的迷失為招討使。

translations.literal: Associate administrator Li Heng was made Mongol and Han army chief commander-in-chief; Mangudai was made Fujian Route pacification commissioner; Zhang Rongshi and Zhang Ding were both made Hubei Route pacification commissioners; and Yeshimishi was made campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator Li Heng was made Mongol and Han army chief commander-in-chief; Mangudai was made Fujian Route pacification commissioner; Zhang Rongshi and Zhang Ding were both made Hubei Route pacification commissioners; and Yeshimishi was made campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，追毀宋故官所受告身。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, appointment patents received by former Song officials were recalled and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, appointment patents received by former Song officials were recalled and destroyed.

sentences.zh: 以嘉定、重慶、夔府既平，還侍衛親軍歸本司。

translations.literal: Because Jiading, Chongqing, and Kuifu had been pacified, Palace Guard troops were returned to their original bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiading, Chongqing, and Kuifu had been pacified, Palace Guard troops were returned to their original bureau.

sentences.zh: 遣禮部尚書柴椿等使安南國，詔切責之，仍俾其來朝。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Chai Chun and others were sent as envoys to Annam with an edict sternly rebuking the king and ordering him to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Chai Chun and others were sent as envoys to Annam with an edict sternly rebuking the king and ordering him to come to court.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Liu Shen, mobile left deputy commander-in-chief of the coastal frontier commission, reported, "Fuzhou pacification commissioner Wang Ji'ang had already submitted but again plotted with Zhang Shijie.

sentences.zh: 」積翁上言：「兵力單弱，若不暫從，恐為闔郡生靈之患。

translations.idiomatic: " Ji'ang memorialized, "Our forces are weak; unless I temporarily go along, I fear disaster for the entire prefecture's people.

translations.idiomatic: " An edict pardoned his crime.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，有首高興匿宋金者，詔置勿問。

translations.literal: On renxu day an informer reported someone hiding Song gold; an edict ordered the matter not pursued.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an informer reported someone hiding Song gold; an edict ordered the matter not pursued.

sentences.zh: 兩淮運糧五萬石賑泉州軍民。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain was transported from the Two Huai to relieve Quanzhou military and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand shi of grain was transported from the Two Huai to relieve Quanzhou military and civilians.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，濟南總管張宏以代輸民賦，嘗貸阿裏、阿答赤等銀五百五十錠，不能償，詔依例停征。

translations.literal: On yichou day Jinan chief administrator Zhang Hong, because he had once substituted for the people's tax payments, had borrowed five hundred fifty ingots of silver from Ali and Adachi and could not repay; an edict ordered collection suspended according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Jinan chief administrator Zhang Hong, because he had once substituted for the people's tax payments, had borrowed 550 ingots of silver from Ali and Adachi and could not repay; an edict ordered collection suspended according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復給漳州安撫使沈世隆家貲。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the confiscated property of Zhangzhou pacification commissioner Shen Shilong was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the confiscated property of Zhangzhou pacification commissioner Shen Shilong was restored.

sentences.zh: 世隆前守建寧府，有郭贊者受張世傑檄，誘世隆，世隆執贊斬之。

translations.idiomatic: Shilong had formerly defended Jianning Prefecture; Guo Zan, having received Zhang Shijie's dispatch, tried to win Shilong over; Shilong seized Zan and beheaded him.

translations.idiomatic: Mongudai, because Shilong had executed someone on his own authority, registered his household property.

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What crime did Shilong commit? Restore it to him.

translations.idiomatic: By decree the Quanzhou sea goddess was titled Protector of the State, Bright Manifestation, Harmonious Rectitude, Good Blessings, Manifest Aid, and Heavenly Consort.

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Anxi Prince's chancery reported: "With Chuan-Shu entirely pacified, there are eighty-three walled cities, stockaded towns, and caves; of these, thirty-three places such as Liyi City in Qu Prefecture should be garrisoned, and the rest altogether dismantled.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

translations.literal: On jimao day chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions were first established in Uighur territories.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day chief prosecuting and surveillance commissions were first established in Uighur territories.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以四川平，勞賞軍士鈔二萬一千三百三十九錠。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, because Sichuan was pacified, troops were rewarded with twenty-one thousand three hundred thirty-nine ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, because Sichuan was pacified, troops were rewarded with 21,339 ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，升洺磁為廣平府路。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Luoci was promoted to Guangping Route Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Luoci was promoted to Guangping Route Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Han Bing impeached associate administrator of the Dadu Route general administration Sherifudin for beating a subject to death; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff, removed from office, and two-tenths of his household property confiscated.

translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left associate Dong Wenbing was made privy council signatory; associate administrators Sudu and Pu Shougeng were both made left associates of the Central Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Eastern and Western Sichuan mobile privy councils were abolished; pacification commissions were established at Chengdu, Tongchuan, Chongqing, and Lizhou.

translations.idiomatic: An edict directed sorting of troops registered on all routes: those verified as exhausted in strength were made civilians; those who relied on powerful families to evade service were restored as soldiers.

translations.literal: Sorting officials dispatched and officials of the local prefectures and counties who could verify correctly without injustice were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Sorting officials dispatched and officials of the local prefectures and counties who could verify correctly without injustice were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 又減至元九年所括三萬軍半以為民，其商戶余丁軍並除之。

translations.literal: Half of the thirty thousand troops registered in the ninth year of Zhiyuan were reduced to civilians; merchant household surplus-male troops were all removed.
translations.idiomatic: Half of the 30,000 troops registered in the ninth year of Zhiyuan were reduced to civilians; merchant household surplus-male troops were all removed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以征東元帥府治東京。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Eastern Campaign Marshal's Headquarters was established at Tokyo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Eastern Campaign Marshal's Headquarters was established at Tokyo.

translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left associate and Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made right associate of the Central Secretariat.

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; apart from the standing offerings, sheep, deer, pigs, and grape wine were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; apart from the standing offerings, sheep, deer, pigs, and grape wine were added.

translations.literal: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑別十八里、日忽思等饑民鈔二千五百錠。

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day 2,500 ingots of paper currency were granted to relieve famine among the people of Bieshibali, Rihusi, and other places.

translations.idiomatic: Two thousand Han troops and one thousand new troops from Kuifu were assigned to Tachai to command.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Orthodox Unity temple was completed; an edict directed Zhang Liusun to reside there.

translations.literal: On dingmao day the prohibition on cutting firewood in mountain preserves was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the prohibition on cutting firewood in mountain preserves was relaxed.
