translations.literal: On jisi day the branch secretariat was urged to build sea vessels and deliver them to Umar and Zhang Hongfan; four thousand additional troops were assigned for them to command.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the branch secretariat was urged to build sea vessels and deliver them to Umar and Zhang Hongfan; four thousand additional troops were assigned for them to command.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕御史臺，凡軍官私役軍士者，視數多寡定其罪。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the Censorate was directed: wherever military officers privately employ soldiers, guilt shall be fixed according to the number.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Censorate was directed: wherever military officers privately employ soldiers, guilt shall be fixed according to the number.

sentences.zh: 詔：「河西、西京、南京、西川、北京等處宣慰司案牘，宜依江南近例，令按察司磨照。

translations.literal: An edict directed: "Records and documents of pacification commissions in Hexi, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Western Sichuan, Northern Capital, and other places should, following the recent Jiangnan precedent, be audited by the chief prosecuting and surveillance commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Records and documents of pacification commissions in Hexi, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Western Sichuan, Northern Capital, and other places should, following the recent Jiangnan precedent, be audited by the chief prosecuting and surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 」移河南河北道提刑按察司治南京。

translations.literal: " The Henan and Hebei Route chief prosecuting and surveillance commission was moved to govern at the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: " The Henan and Hebei Route chief prosecuting and surveillance commission was moved to govern at the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「失裏伯之弟阿剌與王權府等俘掠良民，失裏伯縱弗問。

translations.literal: Censorate officials reported: "Ala, brother of Shilibo, together with Wang Quanfu and others, captured and plundered good people; Shilibo allowed it and did not investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported, "Ala, brother of Shilibo, together with Wang Quanfu and others, captured and plundered good people; Shilibo allowed it and did not investigate.

sentences.zh: 及遣御史掾詰問，不伏。

translations.literal: When an investigating censor's clerk was sent to question him, he would not confess.
translations.idiomatic: When an investigating censor's clerk was sent to question him, he would not confess.

sentences.zh: 」詔執而鞫之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered him seized and tried.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered him seized and tried.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰朔，棗陽萬戶府言：「李均收撫大洪山寨為宋朱統制所害。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen new moon, the Zaoyang wanhu headquarters reported: "Li Jun, in winning over Dafu Mountain stockade, was killed by Song commander Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengchen new moon, the Zaoyang wanhu headquarters reported, "Li Jun, in winning over Dafu Mountain stockade, was killed by Song commander Zhu.

sentences.zh: 」命賜銀千兩赒其家。

translations.literal: " An order granted one thousand taels of silver to succor his family.
translations.idiomatic: " An order granted one thousand taels of silver to succor his family.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以辰、沅、靖、鎮遠等郡與蠻獠接壤，民不安業，命塔海、程鵬飛並為荊湖北道宣慰使，置司常德路，余官屬留荊南府，供給糧食軍需。

translations.literal: On dinghai day because Chen, Yuan, Jing, Zhenyuan, and other prefectures bordered Miao and Liao peoples and the people could not settle to their occupations, Tachai and Cheng Pengfei were both made Jingbei Hubei Route pacification commissioners; headquarters were established at Changde Route, remaining officials stayed at Jingnan Prefecture, and grain and military supplies were provided.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day because Chen, Yuan, Jing, Zhenyuan, and other prefectures bordered Miao and Liao peoples and the people could not settle to their occupations, Tachai and Cheng Pengfei were both made Jingbei Hubei Route pacification commissioners; headquarters were established at Changde Route, remaining officials stayed at Jingnan Prefecture, and grain and military supplies were provided.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，江東道宣慰使囊加帶言：「江南既平，兵民宜各置官屬，蒙古軍宜分屯大河南北，以余丁編立部伍，絕其虜掠之患。

translations.literal: On renchen day Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Nangadai reported: "With Jiangnan now pacified, military and civilian affairs should each have their own officials; Mongol troops should be posted north and south of the Great River, with surplus males organized into units, to end the scourge of plunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Jiangdong Route pacification commissioner Nangadai reported, "With Jiangnan now pacified, military and civilian affairs should each have their own officials; Mongol troops should be posted north and south of the Great River, with surplus males organized into units, to end the scourge of plunder.

sentences.zh: 分揀官僚，本以革阿合馬濫設之弊。

translations.literal: Sorting officials was originally meant to remedy the abuse of excessive appointments under Ahmad.
translations.idiomatic: Sorting officials was originally meant to remedy Ahmad's abuse of excessive appointments.

sentences.zh: 其將校立功者，例行沙汰，何以勸後？

translations.literal: Yet officers and commanders who had won merit are being purged according to routine—how is this to encourage those who follow?
translations.idiomatic: Yet meritorious officers and commanders are being purged by routine—how will that encourage those who come after?

sentences.zh: 新附軍士，宜令行省賜其衣糧，無使闕乏。

translations.literal: Newly attached soldiers should be granted clothing and grain by the branch secretariat so they do not go short.
translations.idiomatic: Newly attached soldiers should receive clothing and grain from the branch secretariat so they are not left wanting.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.

sentences.zh: 征宋相馬廷鸞、章鑒赴闕。

translations.literal: Song grand councilors Ma Tingluan and Zhang Jian were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Song grand councilors Ma Tingluan and Zhang Jian were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，開酒禁。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the ban on alcohol was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the ban on alcohol was lifted.

sentences.zh: 復阿合馬子忽辛、阿散先等官。

translations.literal: The offices of Ahmad's sons Husin, Asanxian, and others were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The offices of Ahmad's sons Husin, Asanxian, and others were restored.

sentences.zh: 始，忽辛等以崔斌論列而免，至是以張惠請，故復之。

translations.literal: Earlier Husin and the others had been dismissed because Cui Bin had impeached them; now, at Zhang Hui's request, they were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Husin and the others had been dismissed after Cui Bin impeached them; now, at Zhang Hui's request, they were restored.

sentences.zh: 惠又請復其子麻速忽及其侄別都魯丁、苫思丁前職，帝疑惠，不從。

translations.literal: Hui also asked to restore his son Masu Hu and his nephews Baiduludin and Shamsuddin to their former posts; the Emperor distrusted Hui and did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Hui also asked to restore his son Masu Hu and his nephews Baiduludin and Shamsuddin to their former posts; the Emperor distrusted Hui and refused.

sentences.zh: 敕已除官僚不之任者，除名為農。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that officials who had been appointed but did not take up their posts be struck from the register and made farmers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials who had been appointed but never took office struck from the register and made farmers.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，召陳巖入覲。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Chen Yan was summoned to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Chen Yan was summoned to court for audience.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貸侍衛軍屯田者鈔二千錠市牛具。

translations.literal: On jihai day two thousand ingots of notes were loaned to Imperial Guard garrison-farming troops to buy cattle and implements.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day two thousand ingots of notes were loaned to Imperial Guard garrison-farming troops to buy cattle and farm tools.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，建寧政和縣人黃華，集鹽夫，聯絡建寧、括蒼及纁民婦自稱許夫人為亂，詔調兵討之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Huang Hua of Zhenghe County, Jianning, gathered salt laborers, linked up with Jianning, Kuocang, and townspeople, and with a woman styling herself Madam Xu raised rebellion; troops were ordered mobilized to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Huang Hua of Zhenghe County in Jianning gathered salt laborers, linked up with people in Jianning, Kuocang, and nearby towns, and with a woman calling herself Madam Xu raised rebellion; troops were ordered out to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行中書省自揚州移治杭州，立淮東宣慰司於揚州，以阿剌罕為宣慰使。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the mobile Central Secretariat moved its seat from Yangzhou to Hangzhou; a Huai-east Pacification Commission was established at Yangzhou, with Alaghan as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the mobile Central Secretariat moved from Yangzhou to Hangzhou; a Huai-east pacification commission was set up at Yangzhou, with Alaghan as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔諭沿海官司通日本國人市舶。

translations.literal: An edict instructed coastal offices to permit Japanese merchant vessels to trade.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed coastal offices to allow Japanese merchant vessels to trade.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事程鵬飛行荊湖北道宣慰使。

translations.literal: Associate Administrator Cheng Pengfei was ordered to conduct Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator Cheng Pengfei was ordered to conduct Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌朔，羅氏鬼國主阿榨、西南蕃主韋昌盛並內附，詔阿榨、韋昌盛各為其地安撫使，佩虎符。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the gengxu new moon, the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and the southwestern tribal chief Wei Changsheng both submitted; an edict made A Zha and Wei Changsheng pacification commissioners of their respective territories, each granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the gengxu new moon, the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and the southwestern tribal chief Wei Changsheng both submitted; an edict made A Zha and Wei Changsheng pacification commissioners of their respective territories, each with a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太白、熒惑、填星聚於房。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered in the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered in the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸光祿寺。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor visited the Directorate of Foodstuffs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor visited the directorate of foodstuffs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔禿魯赤同潭州行省官一員，察戍還病軍所過州縣不加顧恤者按之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict ordered Tulüchi, together with one Tanzhou branch secretariat official, to investigate prefectures and counties along the route of garrison troops returning sick that had failed to care for them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered Tulüchi, together with one Tanzhou branch secretariat official, to investigate prefectures and counties that had failed to care for garrison troops returning sick along their route.

sentences.zh: 甲子，發蒙古、漢軍都元帥張弘範攻漳州，得山寨百五十、戶百萬一。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Mongol and Han army grand marshal Zhang Hongfan attacked Zhang Prefecture, taking one hundred fifty mountain stockades and 1,010,000 households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Mongol and Han army grand marshal Zhang Hongfan attacked Zhang Prefecture, taking one hundred fifty mountain stockades and 1,010,000 households.

sentences.zh: 是日，諜報文天祥見屯潮陽港，亟遣先鋒張弘正、總管囊加帶率輕騎五百人，追及於五坡嶺麓中，大敗之，斬首七千餘，執文天祥及其將校四人赴都。

translations.literal: That same day scouts reported Wen Tianxiang encamped at Chaoyang Harbor; vanguard Zhang Hongzheng and zongguan Nangadai were urgently dispatched with five hundred light cavalry, overtook him at the foot of Wupo Ridge, routed his force, beheaded more than seven thousand, and escorted Wen Tianxiang and four of his commanders to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That same day scouts reported Wen Tianxiang encamped at Chaoyang Harbor; vanguard Zhang Hongzheng and zongguan Nangadai were urgently sent with five hundred light cavalry, overtook him at the foot of Wupo Ridge, routed his force, beheaded more than seven thousand, and escorted Wen Tianxiang and four of his commanders to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，簽書西川行樞密院昝順招誘都掌蠻夷及其屬百一十人內附，以其長阿永為西南番蠻安撫使，得蘭紐為都掌蠻安撫使，賜虎符，余授宣敕、金銀符有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jimao day: Zan Shun, signatory of the Western Sichuan Branch Privy Council, induced Duzhang barbarians and one hundred ten of their dependents to submit; their leader A Yong was made Southwestern Tribal Pacification Commissioner, Delanniu was made Duzhang Barbarian Pacification Commissioner, granted tiger tallies, and the rest received patent edicts and gold and silver tallies in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jimao day: Zan Shun, signatory of the Western Sichuan branch privy council, induced Duzhang barbarians and one hundred ten of their dependents to submit; their leader A Yong was made southwestern tribal pacification commissioner, Delanniu was made Duzhang barbarian pacification commissioner and granted a tiger tally, and the rest received patent edicts and gold and silver tallies in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，思州安撫使田景賢、播州安撫使楊邦憲請歸宋舊借鎮遠、黃平二城，仍徹戍卒，不允。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian and Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian asked to return Zhenyuan and Huangping, two cities formerly borrowed from Song, and to withdraw garrison troops; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian and Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian asked to return Zhenyuan and Huangping, two cities formerly borrowed from Song, and to withdraw garrison troops; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 景賢等請降詔禁戍卒毋擾思、播之民，從之。

translations.literal: Jingxian and the others asked that an edict be issued forbidding garrison troops from harassing the people of Sizhou and Bozhou; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxian and the others asked for an edict forbidding garrison troops from harassing the people of Sizhou and Bozhou; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 鴨池等處招討使欽察所領南征新軍，不能自贍者千人，命屯田於京兆。

translations.literal: One thousand newly attached southern-campaign troops under Qincha, pacification commissioner of Yachi and other places, who could not support themselves were ordered to garrison-farm at Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand newly attached southern-campaign troops under Qincha, pacification commissioner of Yachi and other places, who could not support themselves were ordered to garrison-farm at Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伯顏以渡江收撫沙陽、新城、陽羅堡、閩、浙等郡獲功軍士及降臣姓名來上，詔授虎符者入覲，千戶以下並從行省授官。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Bayan submitted the names of meritorious soldiers and surrendered officials from the Yangzi crossing pacification of Shayang, Xincheng, Yangluo Fort, Min, Zhe, and other commanderies; those granted tiger tallies were ordered to come to audience; ranks below qianhu were all to receive appointment from the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Bayan submitted the names of meritorious soldiers and surrendered officials from the Yangzi crossing pacification of Shayang, Xincheng, Yangluo Fort, Min, Zhe, and other commanderies; those granted tiger tallies were ordered to court; ranks below qianhu were all to receive appointment from the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，揚州行省上將校軍功凡百三十四人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the Yangzhou branch secretariat submitted one hundred thirty-four officers and commanders for military merit; appointments were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Yangzhou branch secretariat submitted one hundred thirty-four officers and commanders for military merit; appointments were granted in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，從播州安撫楊邦憲請，以鼎山仍隸播州。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, at Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian's request, Dingshan was again placed under Bozhou jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, at Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian's request, Dingshan was again placed under Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，敕長春宮修金箓大醮七晝夜。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Changchun Palace was ordered to perform a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Changchun Palace was ordered to perform a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand jiao.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁玉泉山樵采漁弋。

translations.literal: On bingwu day logging, gathering, fishing, and hunting at Jade Spring Mountain were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day logging, gathering, fishing, and hunting at Jade Spring Mountain were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以敘州等處禿老蠻殺使臣撒裏蠻，命發兵討之。

translations.literal: On wushen day, because the Tulao barbarians of Xuzhou and other places had killed envoy Sariman, troops were ordered mobilized to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, because the Tulao barbarians of Xuzhou and other places had killed envoy Sariman, troops were ordered out to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 封伯夷為昭義清惠公，叔齊為崇讓仁惠公。

translations.literal: Boyi was enfeoffed as Duke of Manifest Righteousness and Clear Grace; Shuqi was enfeoffed as Duke of Honored Forbearance and Benevolent Grace.
translations.idiomatic: Boyi was enfeoffed as Duke of Manifest Righteousness and Clear Grace; Shuqi as Duke of Honored Forbearance and Benevolent Grace.

sentences.zh: 以十六年曆日賜高麗。

translations.literal: The calendar for the sixteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: The calendar for the sixteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 海州贛榆縣雹傷稼，免今年田租。

translations.literal: Hail at Ganyu County, Haizhou damaged the crops; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hail at Ganyu County in Haizhou damaged the crops; this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 南寧、吉陽、萬安三郡內附。

translations.literal: Nanning, Jiyang, and Wan'an—the three commanderies—submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Nanning, Jiyang, and Wan'an—the three commanderies—submitted.

sentences.zh: 開成路置屯田總管府，廣安縣隸之。

translations.literal: A garrison-farming commissionerate was established on Kaicheng Route; Guang'an County was placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: A garrison-farming commissionerate was established on Kaicheng Route; Guang'an County was placed under it.

sentences.zh: 臨淄、臨朐、清河復為縣。

translations.literal: Linzi, Linqu, and Qinghe were restored as counties.
translations.idiomatic: Linzi, Linqu, and Qinghe were restored as counties.

sentences.zh: 導肥河入於酅，淤陂盡為良田。

translations.literal: The Fei River was channeled into Xi; silted ponds all became good farmland.
translations.idiomatic: The Fei River was channeled into Xi; silted ponds all became good farmland.

sentences.zh: 會諸王於大都，以平宋所俘寶玉器幣分賜之。

translations.literal: The princes were assembled at Dadu; captured Song treasures, jades, vessels, and silks were divided and granted to them.
translations.idiomatic: The princes were assembled at Dadu; captured Song treasures, jades, vessels, and silks were divided and granted to them.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王等金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes and others were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and others received gold, silver, coin, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西京奉聖州及彰德等處水旱民饑，賑米八萬八百九十石、粟三萬六千四十石、鈔二萬四千八百八十錠有奇。

translations.literal: That year in Fengsheng Prefecture of the Western Capital and Zhangde and other places, flood and drought left the people hungry; relief of eighty thousand eight hundred ninety shi of rice, thirty-six thousand forty shi of millet, and more than twenty-four thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of notes was issued.
translations.idiomatic: That year in Fengsheng Prefecture of the Western Capital and Zhangde and other places, flood and drought left the people hungry; relief of eighty thousand eight hundred ninety shi of rice, thirty-six thousand forty shi of millet, and more than twenty-four thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of notes was issued.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪五十二人。

translations.literal: Fifty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-two persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月己酉朔，高麗國王王愖遣其簽議中贊金方慶來賀，兼奉歲幣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on the jiyou new moon, King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo dispatched his Privy Council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and also present the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on the jiyou new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his privy council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and present the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷五翼探馬赤重役軍。

translations.literal: On renzi day the Five-Wing tümens' heavy-service scout cavalry were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Five-Wing tümens' heavy-service scout cavalry were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，汪良臣言：「西川軍官父死子繼，勤勞四十年，乞顯加爵秩。

translations.literal: On guichou day Wang Liangchen said: "Western Sichuan military officers who inherit posts from father to son have served diligently for forty years; I ask that their ranks and titles be conspicuously advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Wang Liangchen said, "Western Sichuan military officers who inherit posts from father to son have served diligently for forty years; I ask that their ranks and titles be conspicuously advanced.

sentences.zh: 」詔從其請。

translations.literal: " An edict granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict granted his request.

sentences.zh: 詔以海南、瓊崖、儋、萬諸郡俱平，令阿裏海牙入覲。

translations.literal: An edict, because Hainan, Qiongya, Dan, Wan, and all commanderies were fully pacified, ordered Ala Haiya to come to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: An edict, because Hainan, Qiongya, Dan, Wan, and all commanderies were fully pacified, ordered Ala Haiya to court for audience.

sentences.zh: 瀘州降臣趙金、吳大才、袁禹繩等從征重慶，其家屬為叛者所殺，詔賜鈔有差，仍以叛者妻孥付金等。

translations.literal: Luzhou surrendered subjects Zhao Jin, Wu Dacai, Yuan Yusheng, and others had followed the campaign against Chongqing; their families were killed by rebels; an edict granted notes in graded amounts and handed the rebels' wives and children to Jin and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou surrendered subjects Zhao Jin, Wu Dacai, Yuan Yusheng, and others had joined the campaign against Chongqing; their families were killed by rebels; an edict granted notes in graded amounts and handed the rebels' wives and children to Jin and the others.

sentences.zh: 敕高麗國置大灰艾州、東京、柳石、孛落四驛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Goryeo to establish relay stations at Dahui'ai Prefecture, Dongjing, Liushi, and Beluo—four in all.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Goryeo to establish relay stations at Dahui'ai Prefecture, Dongjing, Liushi, and Beluo—four in all.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，無籍軍侵掠平民，而諸王只必帖木兒所部為暴尤甚，命捕為首者置之法。

translations.literal: On jiayin day unregistered troops plundered civilians, and the troops under Prince Jibitenemür were especially violent; the ringleaders were ordered captured and punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day unregistered troops plundered civilians, and the troops under Prince Jibitenemür were especially violent; the ringleaders were ordered captured and punished by law.

sentences.zh: 敕移贛州行省還隆興。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ganzhou branch secretariat moved back to Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ganzhou branch secretariat moved back to Longxing.

sentences.zh: 高麗國來獻方物。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，合州安撫使王立以城降。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Hezhou pacification commissioner Wang Li surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hezhou pacification commissioner Wang Li surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 先是，立遣間使降安西王相李德輝，東川行院與德輝爭功，德輝單舸至城下，呼立出降，川蜀以平。

translations.literal: Earlier Wang Li had sent a secret envoy to surrender to Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui; the Eastern Chuan branch privy council and Dehui disputed credit; Dehui came alone in a single boat to the foot of the walls, called for Li to come out and surrender, and Chuan-Shu was thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Li had sent a secret envoy to surrender to Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui; the Eastern Chuan branch privy council and Dehui disputed credit; Dehui came alone in a single boat to the foot of the walls, called for Li to come out and surrender, and Chuan-Shu was thereby pacified.

sentences.zh: 東川行院遂言，立久抗王師，嘗指斥憲宗，宜殺之。

translations.literal: The Eastern Chuan branch privy council thereupon reported that Li had long resisted the royal army and had once denounced Möngke Khan; he should be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Chuan branch privy council thereupon reported that Li had long resisted the royal army and had once denounced Möngke Khan; he should be executed.

sentences.zh: 樞密院以其事聞，而降臣李諒亦訟立前殺其妻子，有其財物，遂詔殺立，籍其家貲償諒。

translations.literal: The Privy Council reported the matter; and the surrendered subject Li Liang also sued Li for having earlier killed his wife and children and seized his property; an edict was thereupon issued to execute Li and confiscate his estate to compensate Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Council reported the matter; and the surrendered subject Li Liang also sued Li for having earlier killed his wife and children and seized his property; an edict was thereupon issued to execute Li and confiscate his estate to compensate Liang.

sentences.zh: 既而安西王具立降附本末來上，且言東川院臣憤李德輝受降之故，誣奏誅立。

translations.literal: Afterward the Anxi King's full account of Li's surrender and submission was submitted, stating also that Eastern Chuan privy council officials, angered that Li Dehui had received the surrender, had falsely reported to procure Li's execution.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the Anxi King's full account of Li's surrender was submitted, stating also that Eastern Chuan privy council officials, angered that Li Dehui had received the surrender, had falsely reported to procure Li's execution.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣亦以前奏為非。

translations.literal: Privy Council officials also held the earlier memorial to have been wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council officials also held the earlier memorial to have been wrong.

sentences.zh: 帝怒曰：「卿視人命若戲耶！

translations.literal: The Emperor angrily said: "Do you treat human life as a jest?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor angrily said, "Do you treat human life as a jest?

sentences.zh: 前遣使計殺立久矣，今追悔何及。

translations.literal: The envoy to execute Li was dispatched long ago; what good is regret now?
translations.idiomatic: The envoy to execute Li was dispatched long ago—what good is regret now?

sentences.zh: 卿等妄殺人，其歸待罪。

translations.literal: You have killed a man recklessly—return and await punishment.
translations.idiomatic: You have killed a man recklessly—return and await punishment.

sentences.zh: 」斥出之。

translations.literal: " They were dismissed and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: " They were dismissed and expelled.

sentences.zh: 會安西王使再至，言未殺立。

translations.literal: It happened that the Anxi King's envoy came again, reporting that Li had not been killed.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Anxi King's envoy came again, reporting that Li had not been killed.

sentences.zh: 即召立入覲，命為潼川路安撫使，知合州事。

translations.literal: Li was immediately summoned to court for audience and appointed pacification commissioner of Tongchuan Route, with charge of Hezhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li was immediately summoned to court and appointed pacification commissioner of Tongchuan Route, with charge of Hezhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，分川蜀為四道：以成都等路為四川西道，廣元等路為四川北道，重慶等路為四川南道，順慶等路為四川東道，並立宣慰司。

translations.literal: On renxu day Chuan-Shu was divided into four circuits: Chengdu and other routes as Sichuan Western Circuit, Guangyuan and other routes as Sichuan Northern Circuit, Chongqing and other routes as Sichuan Southern Circuit, Shunqing and other routes as Sichuan Eastern Circuit—pacification commissions established in each.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Chuan-Shu was divided into four circuits: Chengdu and other routes as Sichuan Western Circuit, Guangyuan and other routes as Sichuan Northern Circuit, Chongqing and other routes as Sichuan Southern Circuit, and Shunqing and other routes as Sichuan Eastern Circuit, with pacification commissions established in each.

sentences.zh: 賞重慶等處從征蒙古、漢軍鈔三萬九千九百五十一錠。

translations.literal: Mongol and Han troops from Chongqing and elsewhere who had joined the campaign were rewarded with thirty-nine thousand nine hundred fifty-one ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol and Han troops from Chongqing and elsewhere who had joined the campaign were rewarded with thirty-nine thousand nine hundred fifty-one ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 改播州鼎山縣為播川縣。

translations.literal: Dingshan County of Bozhou was renamed Bochuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Dingshan County of Bozhou was renamed Bochuan County.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜參知政事昝順田民百八十戶於江津縣。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Associate Administrator Zan Shun was granted one hundred eighty farming households in Jiangjin County.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day associate administrator Zan Shun was granted one hundred eighty farming households in Jiangjin County.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，立河西屯田，給耕具，遣官領之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Hexi garrison farming was established; farm implements were supplied and officials dispatched to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Hexi garrison farming was established; farm implements were supplied and officials dispatched to supervise.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，張弘範將兵追宋二王至崖山寨，張世傑來拒戰，敗之，世傑遁去，廣王昺偕其官屬俱赴海死，獲其金寶以獻。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Zhang Hongfan led troops pursuing the two Song princes to Yashan stockade; Zhang Shijie came to resist and was defeated; Shijie fled; Prince of Guang Zhao Bing together with his officials all went to their deaths at sea; their gold and treasures were captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhang Hongfan led troops pursuing the two Song princes to Yashan stockade; Zhang Shijie came to resist and was defeated; Shijie fled; Prince of Guang Zhao Bing together with his officials all went to their deaths at sea; their gold and treasures were captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諭又巴、散毛等四洞番蠻酋長使降。

translations.literal: On bingzi day an edict instructed the tribal chiefs of the four cave-dwelling barbarian domains of Youba, Sanmao, and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict instructed the tribal chiefs of the four cave-dwelling barbarian domains of Youba, Sanmao, and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 以中書左丞別乞裏迷失同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Begirmish was made associate director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Begirmish was made associate director of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 禁中書省文冊奏檢用畏吾字書。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat was forbidden to use Uighur script in official documents, memorials, and reports.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was forbidden to use Uighur script in official documents, memorials, and reports.

sentences.zh: 賜異樣等局官吏工匠銀二千兩。

translations.literal: Officials, clerks, and craftsmen of the Miscellaneous Manufactures Bureau and related offices were granted two thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, clerks, and craftsmen of the Miscellaneous Manufactures Bureau and related offices were granted two thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子奧魯赤及諸王拜答罕下軍士與思州田師賢所部軍衣服及鈔有差。

translations.literal: Graded gifts of clothing and notes were granted to Prince Orluk, soldiers under Prince Beg Qaghan, and the troops under Sizhou's Tian Shixian.
translations.idiomatic: Graded gifts of clothing and notes were granted to Prince Orluk, soldiers under Prince Beg Qaghan, and the troops under Sizhou's Tian Shixian.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅朔，祭先農於籍田。

translations.literal: Second month, on the wuyin new moon, the Former Farmer was sacrificed to at the registry field.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on the wuyin new moon, the Former Farmer was sacrificed to at the registry field.

sentences.zh: 壬午，升溧州為路。

translations.literal: On renwu day Li Prefecture was promoted to a route.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Li Prefecture was promoted to a route.

sentences.zh: 遣使訪求通皇極數番陽祝泌子孫，其甥傅立持泌書來上，撥民萬戶隸明裏淘金。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to seek descendants of Poyang Zhu Bi, who had mastered the Imperial Ultimate number; his nephew Fu Li came bearing Bi's books; ten thousand commoner households were assigned to Mingli's gold panning.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to seek descendants of Poyang Zhu Bi, who had mastered the Imperial Ultimate number; his nephew Fu Li came bearing Bi's books; ten thousand commoner households were assigned to Mingli's gold panning.

sentences.zh: 以江南漕運舊米賑軍民之饑者。

translations.literal: Old grain from Jiangnan grain transport was used to relieve hungry soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Old grain from Jiangnan grain transport was used to relieve hungry soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 癸未，增置五衛指揮司。

translations.literal: On guiwei day five guard command offices were added.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day five guard command offices were added.

sentences.zh: 詔遣塔黑麻合兒、撒兒答帶括中興戶。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Taqamaqar and Sartai to register households in Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Taqamaqar and Sartai to register households in Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 太史令王恂等言：「建司天臺於大都，儀象圭表皆銅為之，宜增銅表高至四十尺，則景長而真。

translations.literal: Director of Astronomy Wang Heng and others said: "In building the observatory at Dadu, the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and sundial gnomon are all made of bronze; the bronze gnomon should be raised to forty feet in height, so the shadow will be longer and more accurate.
translations.idiomatic: Director of astronomy Wang Heng and others said, "In building the observatory at Dadu, the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and sundial gnomon are all made of bronze; the bronze gnomon should be raised to forty feet in height, so the shadow will be longer and more accurate.

sentences.zh: 又請上都、洛陽等五處分置儀表，各選監候官。

translations.literal: They also asked that instruments be placed separately at five locations—Shangdu, Luoyang, and others—with observatory officers selected at each.
translations.idiomatic: They also asked that instruments be placed separately at five locations—Shangdu, Luoyang, and others—with observatory officers selected at each.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " This was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，平章阿裏伯乞行中書省檢核行御史臺文案，且請行臺呈行省，比御史呈中書省例，從之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Grand Councillor Alibo asked that the branch Central Secretariat review branch Censorate documents, and also that the branch Censorate submit to the branch secretariat, on the model of censors submitting to the Central Secretariat; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day grand councillor Alibo asked that the branch Central Secretariat review branch Censorate documents, and also that the branch Censorate submit to the branch secretariat on the model of censors submitting to the Central Secretariat; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以征日本，敕揚州、湖南、贛州、泉州四省造戰船六百艘。

translations.literal: In preparation for the campaign against Japan, an edict ordered Yangzhou, Hunan, Ganzhou, and Quanzhou—four branch secretariats—to build six hundred warships.
translations.idiomatic: In preparation for the campaign against Japan, an edict ordered Yangzhou, Hunan, Ganzhou, and Quanzhou—four branch secretariats—to build six hundred warships.

sentences.zh: 移紹興宣慰司於處州。

translations.literal: The Shaoxing Pacification Commission was moved to Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing pacification commission was moved to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，調潭州行省軍五千戍沿海州郡。

translations.literal: On jichou day five thousand Tanzhou branch secretariat troops were mobilized to garrison coastal prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day five thousand Tanzhou branch secretariat troops were mobilized to garrison coastal prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，張弘範以降臣陳懿兄弟破賊有功，且出戰船百艘從征宋二王，請授懿招討使兼潮州路軍民總管，及其弟忠、義、勇三人為管軍總管，千夫長塔剌海獲文天祥有功，請授總管軍千戶，佩符，並從之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Zhang Hongfan, because surrendered subject Chen Yi and his brothers had merit in defeating bandits and had provided one hundred warships for the campaign against the two Song princes, asked that Yi be made pacification commissioner concurrently commander-in-chief of Chaozhou Route military and civilian affairs, and his brothers Zhong, Yi, and Yong be made army commanders; qianhu Talqai had merit in capturing Wen Tianxiang, and was asked to be made commander qianhu with tally—all granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Zhang Hongfan, because surrendered subject Chen Yi and his brothers had merit in defeating bandits and had provided one hundred warships for the campaign against the two Song princes, asked that Yi be made pacification commissioner and concurrently commander-in-chief of Chaozhou Route military and civilian affairs, and his brothers Zhong, Yi, and Yong be made army commanders; qianhu Talqai had merit in capturing Wen Tianxiang and was asked to be made commander qianhu with tally—all granted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔諭宗師張留孫悉主淮東、淮西、荊襄等處道教。

translations.literal: On renchen day Master Zhang Liusun was instructed by edict to take full charge of Daoism in Huai-east, Huai-west, Jing-Xiang, and other regions.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Master Zhang Liusun was instructed by edict to take full charge of Daoism in Huai-east, Huai-west, Jing-Xiang, and other regions.

sentences.zh: 乙未，玉速帖木兒言：「行臺文卷令行省檢核，於事不便。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Yusut Temür said: "Having branch Censorate documents reviewed by the branch secretariat is inconvenient in practice.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Yusut Temür said, "Having branch Censorate documents reviewed by the branch secretariat is inconvenient in practice.

sentences.zh: 」詔改之，其運司文卷聽御史臺檢核。

translations.literal: " An edict changed the arrangement; transport commission documents were left to Censorate review.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict changed the arrangement; transport commission documents were left to Censorate review.

sentences.zh: 饒州路達魯花赤玉古倫擅用羨余糧四千四百石，杖之，仍沒其家。

translations.literal: Yüguren, darughachi of Raozhou Route, misappropriated four thousand four hundred shi of surplus grain; he was beaten with the staff and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Yüguren, darughachi of Raozhou Route, misappropriated four thousand four hundred shi of surplus grain; he was beaten with the staff and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 詔湖南行省於戍軍還途，每四五十里立安樂堂，疾者醫之，饑者廩之，死者槁葬之，官給其需。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Hunan branch secretariat that along the return route of garrison troops, at every forty or fifty li an Ease-and-Comfort Hall was to be established—to treat the sick, provision the hungry, and coffin-bury the dead, with costs supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Hunan branch secretariat that along garrison troops' return route, at every forty or fifty li an Ease-and-Comfort Hall was to be established—to treat the sick, feed the hungry, and coffin-bury the dead, with costs supplied by the government.

sentences.zh: 遣官核實益都、淄萊、濟南逃亡民地之為行營牧地者。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to verify lands of escaped commoners in Yidu, Zilai, and Jinan that had been made into mobile camp pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to verify lands of escaped commoners in Yidu, Zilai, and Jinan that had been made into mobile camp pasture.

sentences.zh: 禁諸奧魯及漢人持弓矢，其出征之所持兵仗，即輸之官庫。

translations.literal: Among all ordo households and Han people, possession of bows and arrows was forbidden; weapons carried on campaign were to be turned in to the government arsenal afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Among all ordo households and Han people, possession of bows and arrows was forbidden; weapons carried on campaign were to be turned in to the government arsenal afterward.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜太史院銀一千七十八兩。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Directorate of Astronomy was granted one thousand seventy-eight taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the directorate of astronomy was granted one thousand seventy-eight taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，發嘉定新附軍千人屯田脫裏北之地。

translations.literal: On guimao day one thousand newly attached troops from Jiading were sent to garrison-farm at Tuoli North.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day one thousand newly attached troops from Jiading were sent to garrison-farm at Tuoli North.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，升大都兵馬都指揮使司秩四品。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the Dadu Cavalry and Infantry Command was raised to rank four.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Dadu cavalry and infantry command was raised to rank four.

sentences.zh: 詔大都、河間、山東管鹽運司並兼管酒、醋、商稅等課程。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the salt transport offices of Dadu, Hejian, and Shandong also jointly to manage wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other revenue items.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dadu, Hejian, and Shandong salt transport offices also to manage wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other revenue items.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣請以真定路達魯花赤蒙古帶為保定路達魯花赤，帝曰：「此正人也，朕將別以大事付之。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials requested making Darughachi Mongol-tai of Zhending circuit Darughachi of Baoding circuit; the emperor said: "This is an upright man; I shall entrust him with another great matter separately."
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat asked to appoint Zhending circuit darughachi Mongol-tai as darughachi of Baoding circuit; the emperor said, "This is an upright man; I shall give him another great task."

sentences.zh: 」賞汪良臣所部蒙古、漢軍收附四川功鈔五萬錠。

translations.literal: Wang Liangchen's Mongol and Han troops were rewarded with fifty thousand ingots of notes for the merit of receiving submission in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liangchen's Mongol and Han troops were rewarded with 50,000 ingots of notes for receiving submission in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 命嘉定以西新鄭州郡及田、楊二家諸貴官子，俱充質子入侍。

translations.literal: It was ordered that newly submitted prefectures and districts west of Jiading, and the sons of eminent officials of the Tian and Yang families, all serve as hostages at court.
translations.idiomatic: It was ordered that newly submitted prefectures and districts west of Jiading, and the sons of eminent officials of the Tian and Yang families, all serve as hostages at court.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage went to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命同知太史院事郭守敬訪求精天文歷數者。

translations.literal: On yisi day Guo Shoujing, associate director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau, was ordered to seek out and recruit those skilled in astronomy and calendrical computation.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Guo Shoujing, associate director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau, was ordered to seek out experts in astronomy and calendrical computation.

sentences.zh: 西蜀四川道立提刑按察司。

translations.literal: A judicial inspection commission was established for the Western Sichuan Sichuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A judicial inspection commission was established for the Western Sichuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使代祀嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites on the emperor's behalf to the mountains, rivers, and earth deity.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites on the emperor's behalf to the mountains, rivers, and earth deity.

sentences.zh: 詔河南、西京、北京等路課程，令各道宣慰司領之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that revenue items of Henan, Western Capital, Northern Capital, and other circuits be placed under the respective circuit pacification commissions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed revenue items of Henan, Western Capital, Northern Capital, and other circuits under their respective circuit pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 賞西川新附軍鈔三千八百五十錠。

translations.literal: Western Sichuan newly submitted troops were rewarded with three thousand eight hundred fifty ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sichuan newly submitted troops were rewarded with 3,850 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 以斡端境內蒙古軍耗乏，並漢軍、新附軍等，賜馬牛羊及馬驢價鈔、衣服、弓矢、鞍勒各有差。

translations.literal: Because Mongol troops within Hotan territory were depleted, Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were granted horses, cattle, and sheep, and paper currency for horses and donkeys, clothing, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mongol troops in Hotan territory were depleted, Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were granted horses, cattle, and sheep, plus paper currency for horses and donkeys, clothing, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申朔，詔禁歸德、亳、壽、臨淮等處畋獵。

translations.literal: Third month, wushen new moon: an edict forbade hunting at Guide, Bo, Shou, Linhuai, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wushen new moon: an edict forbade hunting at Guide, Bo, Shou, Linhuai, and other places.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，敕郭守敬繇上都、大都，歷河南府抵南海，測驗晷景。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Guo Shoujing was commanded to travel from Shangdu and Dadu, passing through Henan prefecture to the Southern Sea, to measure and test shadow lengths.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Guo Shoujing was commanded to travel from Shangdu and Dadu, through Henan prefecture to the Southern Sea, to measure shadow lengths.

sentences.zh: 壬子，囊加帶括兩淮造回回炮新附軍匠六百，及蒙古、回回、漢人、新附人能造炮者，俱至京師。

translations.literal: On renzi day Nangadai mustered six hundred newly submitted artisan troops from the two Huai regions who made Muslim-style catapults, and all Mongols, Muslims, Han Chinese, and newly submitted persons who could make catapults were sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Nangadai mustered 600 newly submitted artisan troops from the two Huai regions who made Muslim-style catapults, and all Mongols, Muslims, Han Chinese, and newly submitted persons who could make catapults were sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，給千戶馬乃部下拔突軍及土渾川軍屯田牛具。

translations.literal: On gengshen day plowing oxen and implements were issued to the batu troops and Tu-hun River troops under qianhu Ma-nai for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day plowing oxen and implements were issued to the batu troops and Tu-hun River troops under qianhu Ma-nai for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，敕中書省，凡掾史文移稽緩一日二日者杖，三日者死。
