translations.literal: With Western Sichuan pacified, garrison farming was re-established; military officers were promoted by graded merit; in all one hundred sixty-one received appointment edicts and gold and silver tallies.
translations.idiomatic: With Western Sichuan pacified, garrison farming was re-established; military officers were promoted by graded merit; in all 161 received appointment edicts and gold and silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 詔以高州、筠連州騰川縣新附戶於漵州等處治道立驛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered newly submitted households of Tengchuan county, Gaozhou and Junlian prefectures to establish relay stations along roads maintained at Xuzhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered newly submitted households of Tengchuan county, Gaozhou and Junlian prefectures to establish relay stations along roads maintained at Xuzhou and other places.

sentences.zh: 雲南都元帥愛魯、納速剌丁招降西南諸國。

translations.literal: Yunnan commander-in-chief Ailu and Nasir al-Din recruited southwestern countries to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan commander-in-chief Ailu and Nasir al-Din recruited southwestern countries to submit.

sentences.zh: 愛魯將兵分定亦乞不薛，納速剌丁將大理軍抵金齒、蒲驃、曲蠟、緬國界內，招忙木、巨木禿等寨三百，籍戶十一萬二百。

translations.literal: Ailu led troops separately to pacify Yiqibuxie; Nasir al-Din led Dali troops to the borders within Jinch'i, Piao, Qucan, and Burma, recruiting three hundred stockades including Mangmu and Jumutu, registering one hundred ten thousand two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Ailu led troops separately to pacify Yiqibuxie; Nasir al-Din led Dali troops to the borders within Jinch'i, Piao, Qucan, and Burma, recruiting 300 stockades including Mangmu and Jumutu, registering 110,200 households.

sentences.zh: 詔定賦租，立站遞，設衛送軍。

translations.literal: An edict fixed land tax and rent, established relay posts, and set up escort guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed land tax and rent, established relay posts, and set up escort guard troops.

sentences.zh: 軍還，獻馴象十二。

translations.literal: When the army returned, twelve tame elephants were presented.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, 12 tame elephants were presented.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，改宣德府龍門鎮復為縣。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Longmen township of Xuande prefecture was changed back to a county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Longmen township of Xuande prefecture was changed back to a county.

sentences.zh: 庚子，拘括河西、西番闌遺戶。

translations.literal: On gengzi day unregistered households of Hexi and Western Tibet were mustered and registered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day unregistered households of Hexi and Western Tibet were mustered and registered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以通州水路淺，舟運甚難，命樞密院發軍五千，仍令食祿諸官雇役千人開浚，以五十日訖工。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, because the Tongzhou water route was shallow and transport by boat very difficult, the Privy Council was ordered to dispatch five thousand troops, and salaried officials were also ordered to hire one thousand laborers for dredging, to be completed in fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the Tongzhou water route was shallow and transport by boat very difficult, the Privy Council was ordered to dispatch 5,000 troops, and salaried officials were also ordered to hire 1,000 laborers for dredging, to be completed in 50 days.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以臨洮、鞏昌、通安等十驛歲饑，供役繁重，有質賣子女以供役者，命選官撫治之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, because the ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an suffered yearly famine and heavy corvee, with some pawning and selling children to meet service obligations, officials were selected to soothe and govern.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an suffered yearly famine and heavy corvee, with some pawning and selling children to meet service obligations, officials were selected to soothe and govern.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以襄陽屯田戶四百代軍當驛役。

translations.literal: On jiachen day four hundred Xiangyang garrison-farming households were ordered to replace troops in performing relay service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day 400 Xiangyang garrison-farming households were ordered to replace troops in performing relay service.

sentences.zh: 賜征北諸郡蒙古軍闊闊八都等力戰有功者銀五十兩，戰歿者家給銀百兩，從行伍者鈔一錠，其餘衣物有差。

translations.literal: Northern campaign Mongol troops including Kokebad who fought with merit were granted fifty taels of silver; families of those killed in battle received one hundred taels of silver; those in the ranks received one ingot of notes; other clothing rewards varied by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Northern campaign Mongol troops including Kokebad who fought with merit were granted 50 taels of silver; families of those killed in battle received 100 taels of silver; those in the ranks received one ingot of notes; other clothing rewards varied by rank.

sentences.zh: 禁伯顏察兒諸峪寨捕獵。

translations.literal: Hunting was forbidden in the various valleys and stockades of Bayan Cher.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting was forbidden in the various valleys and stockades of Bayan Cher.

sentences.zh: 詔免四川差稅。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Sichuan labor and tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted Sichuan labor and tax levies.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事、行中書省事別都魯丁為河南等路宣慰使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of State and branch secretariat affairs Bedruddin was made Henan circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of State and branch secretariat affairs Bedruddin was made Henan circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以阿合馬子忽辛為潭州行省左丞，忽失海牙等並復舊職。

translations.literal: Ahmad's son Husain was made left vice minister of the Tanzhou branch secretariat; Husain Hajib and others were all restored to their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad's son Husain was made left vice minister of the Tanzhou branch secretariat; Husain Hajib and others were all restored to their former posts.

sentences.zh: 占城、馬八兒諸國遣使以珍物及象犀各一來獻。

translations.literal: Champa, Ma'bar, and other countries dispatched envoys presenting rare goods and one elephant and rhinoceros horn each.
translations.idiomatic: Champa, Ma'bar, and other countries dispatched envoys presenting rare goods and one elephant and rhinoceros horn each.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王所部銀鈔、衣服、幣帛、鞍勒、弓矢及羊馬價鈔等各有差。

translations.literal: Princes' subordinates were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and brocades, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and paper currency for sheep and horses, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Princes' subordinates were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and brocades, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and paper currency for sheep and horses, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 五臺山作佛事。

translations.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，寧國路新附軍百戶詹福謀叛，福論死，授告者何士青總把、銀符，仍賜鈔十錠。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wushen day: Ningguo circuit newly submitted troops company commander Zhan Fu plotted rebellion; Fu was sentenced to death; informer He Shiqing was made zongba with a silver tally and granted ten ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wushen day: Ningguo circuit newly submitted troops company commander Zhan Fu plotted rebellion; Fu was sentenced to death; informer He Shiqing was made zongba with a silver tally and granted 10 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 罷西川行省。

translations.literal: The Western Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁脫脫和孫搜取乘傳者私物。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Tutuhe's grandsons were forbidden to search and seize private goods of relay travelers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Tutuhe's grandsons were forbidden to search relay travelers for private goods.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，應昌府依例設官。

translations.literal: On yimao day, officials were established at Yingchang Prefecture according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day officials were established at Yingchang Prefecture according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 置東宮侍衛軍。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace guard army was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace guard army was established.

sentences.zh: 定江南上、中路置達魯花赤二員，下路一員。

translations.literal: It was fixed that two darughachi were to be placed in Jiangnan upper and middle circuits, and one in lower circuits.
translations.idiomatic: It was fixed that Jiangnan upper and middle circuits would have two darughachi each and lower circuits one each.

sentences.zh: 敕發西川蒙古軍七千、新附軍三千，付皇子安西王。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched seven thousand Mongol troops of Western Sichuan and three thousand newly submitted troops to Prince Anxi Wang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched seven thousand Western Sichuan Mongol troops and three thousand newly submitted troops to Prince Anxi Wang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，交趾國遣使來貢馴象。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Jiaozhi sent envoys to present tribute of tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiaozhi sent envoys to present tame elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，以朵哥麻思地之算木多城為鎮西府。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the city of Samudo in Duogemasi territory was made Zhenxi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Samudo in Duogemasi territory was made Zhenxi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 敕以蒙古軍二千、益都軍二千、諸路軍一千、新附軍五千，合萬人，令李庭將之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered two thousand Mongol troops, two thousand Yidu troops, one thousand troops from various routes, and five thousand newly submitted troops — ten thousand in all — to be placed under Li Ting's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered two thousand Mongol troops, two thousand Yidu troops, one thousand troops from various routes, and five thousand newly submitted troops — ten thousand in all — under Li Ting's command.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賞甕吉剌所部力戰軍人銀五十兩，死事者人百兩，給其家。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Önggüd troops who fought hard were rewarded fifty taels of silver each; those killed in action received one hundred taels each, given to their families.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Önggüd troops who fought hard were rewarded fifty taels of silver each; the families of those killed in action received one hundred taels each.

sentences.zh: 阿裏海牙入覲，獻金三千五百八十兩、銀五萬三千一百兩。

translations.literal: Ala Haiya came to audience and presented three thousand five hundred eighty taels of gold and fifty-three thousand one hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Ala Haiya came to audience and presented 3,580 taels of gold and 53,100 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 罷潭州行省造征日本及交趾戰船。

translations.literal: The Tanzhou Branch Secretariat's construction of warships for campaigns against Japan and Jiaozhi was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanzhou Branch Secretariat was ordered to stop building warships for campaigns against Japan and Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，填星犯鍵閉。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Saturn encroached upon Jianbi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Jianbi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，西南八番、羅氏等國來附，洞寨凡千六百二十有六，戶凡十萬一千一百六十有八。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the Southwestern Eight Fan, the Luo clan country, and others submitted — one thousand six hundred twenty-six cave stockades in all, one hundred one thousand one hundred sixty-eight households in all.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Southwestern Eight Fan, the Luo clan country, and others submitted — 1,626 cave stockades and 101,168 households in all.

sentences.zh: 詔遣牙納術、崔彧至江南訪求藝術之人。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Yanash and Cui Yu to Jiangnan to seek out persons skilled in arts and techniques.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Yanash and Cui Yu to Jiangnan to seek out persons skilled in arts and techniques.

sentences.zh: 以中書左丞、行四川行中書省事汪良臣為安西王相。

translations.literal: Left censor of the Central Secretariat and acting Sichuan Branch Secretariat director Wang Liangchen was made chancellor to Prince Anxi Wang.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left censor and acting Sichuan Branch Secretariat director Wang Liangchen was made chancellor to Prince Anxi Wang.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王納裏忽所部有功將校銀鈔、衣裝、幣帛、羊馬有差。

translations.literal: Officers and commanders with merit under Prince Narihu were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and cloth, sheep and horses in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and commanders with merit under Prince Narihu received silver, notes, clothing, silks and cloth, sheep, and horses in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 以趙州等處水旱，減今年租三千一百八十一石。

translations.literal: Because of flood and drought at Zhao Prefecture and other places, this year's land tax was reduced by three thousand one hundred eighty-one shi.
translations.idiomatic: Because of flood and drought at Zhao Prefecture and other places, this year's land tax was reduced by 3,181 shi.

sentences.zh: 命散都修佛事十有五日。

translations.literal: Sando was ordered to perform Buddhist rites for fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Sando was ordered to perform Buddhist rites for fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingchou day: the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingchou day: the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太陰掩房距星。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the moon occulted the determining star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon occulted the determining star of the Room.

sentences.zh: 戊子，範文虎言：「臣奉詔征討日本，比遣周福、欒忠與日本僧賫詔往諭其國，期以來年四月還報，待其從否，始宜進兵。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Fan Wenhu said: "Your subject, bearing the edict to campaign against Japan, recently sent Zhou Fu, Luan Zhong, and a Japanese monk bearing the edict to instruct that country; they are expected to return with a report in the fourth month of next year — only after learning whether they consent should troops be sent."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Fan Wenhu said: "Your subject, under orders to campaign against Japan, recently sent Zhou Fu, Luan Zhong, and a Japanese monk with an edict to instruct that country; they are expected back in the fourth month of next year — only once we know whether they consent should troops advance."

sentences.zh: 」又請簡閱舊戰船以充用。

translations.literal: He also requested that old warships be inspected and used to fill needs.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that old warships be inspected and put to use.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 海賊賀文達率眾來歸文虎，文虎以所得銀三千兩來獻。

translations.literal: The sea bandit He Wenda led his followers to submit to Wenhu; Wenhu presented the three thousand taels of silver he had obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The sea bandit He Wenda led his followers to submit to Fan Wenhu, who presented the three thousand taels of silver he had obtained.

sentences.zh: 有旨釋其前罪，官其徒四十八人，就以銀賜文虎。

translations.literal: An imperial directive pardoned his earlier crimes, appointed forty-eight of his followers to office, and granted the silver to Wenhu as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial directive pardoned his earlier crimes, appointed forty-eight of his followers to office, and granted the silver to Wenhu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宋降臣王虎臣陳便宜十七事，令張易等議，可者行之。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Song submitted subject Wang Huchen presented seventeen practical proposals; Zhang Yi and others were ordered to deliberate — those deemed feasible were implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Song submitted subject Wang Huchen presented seventeen practical proposals; Zhang Yi and others were ordered to deliberate, and feasible ones were implemented.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕沅州路蒙古軍總管乞答合征取桐木籠、犵狫、伯洞諸蠻未附者。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an edict ordered Qadagh, Mongol troops chief controller of Yuanzhou Circuit, to subdue the unsubmitted barbarians of Tongmulong, Gelao, Bodong, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered Qadagh, Mongol troops chief controller of Yuanzhou Circuit, to subdue the unsubmitted barbarians of Tongmulong, Gelao, Bodong, and others.

sentences.zh: 調江南新附軍五千駐太原，五千駐大名，五千駐衛州。

translations.literal: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Jiangnan were transferred to garrison at Taiyuan; five thousand at Daming; five thousand at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand newly submitted Jiangnan troops were posted at Taiyuan, five thousand at Daming, and five thousand at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 以每歲聖誕節及元辰日，禮儀費用皆斂之民，詔天下罷之。

translations.literal: Because ceremonial expenses for the annual birthday and personal fortune day were all levied on the people, an edict ordered this abolished throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Because ceremonial expenses for the annual birthday and personal fortune day were levied on the people, an edict abolished the practice throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以江南所獲玉爵及坫凡四十九事，納於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己亥，海賊金通精死，獲其從子溫，有司欲論如法，帝曰：「通精已死，溫何預焉？

translations.literal: On jihai day, the sea bandit Jin Tongjing died; his nephew Wen was captured. The officials wished to punish according to law. The emperor said: "Tongjing is already dead — what has Wen to do with it?"
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the sea bandit Jin Tongjing died and his nephew Wen was captured; the officials wished to punish him by law. The emperor said: "Tongjing is already dead — what has Wen to do with it?"

sentences.zh: 」特赦其罪。

translations.literal: His crime was specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: His crime was specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚子，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔漢軍出征逃者罪死，且沒其家。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, an edict: Han troops who fled on campaign were sentenced to death, and their families confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered that Han troops who fled on campaign be sentenced to death and their families confiscated.

sentences.zh: 置大護國仁王寺總管府，以散紥兒為達魯花赤，李光祖為總管。

translations.literal: The Chief Directorate of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent Kings Temple was established, with Sanjar as darughachi and Li Guangzu as director-general.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Directorate of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent Kings Temple was established, with Sanjar as darughachi and Li Guangzu as director-general.

sentences.zh: 賜範文虎僚屬二十一人金紋綾及西錦衣。

translations.literal: Twenty-one members of Fan Wenhu's staff were granted gold-patterned gauze and Western brocade clothing.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one members of Fan Wenhu's staff received gold-patterned gauze and Western brocade clothing.

sentences.zh: 賞征重慶將校幣帛有差。

translations.literal: Officers and commanders of the Chongqing campaign were rewarded with silks and cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and commanders of the Chongqing campaign were rewarded with silks and cloth in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王阿只吉糧五千石、馬六百匹、羊萬口。

translations.literal: Prince Ajiji was granted five thousand shi of grain, six hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ajiji received five thousand shi of grain, six hundred horses, and ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳朔，範文虎薦可為守令者三十人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yisi day, first of the month: Fan Wenhu recommended thirty persons suitable to serve as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi day, first of the month: Fan Wenhu recommended thirty persons suitable to serve as prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 詔：「今後所薦，朕自擇之。

translations.literal: An edict: "Recommendations hereafter — I shall choose among them myself.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Recommendations hereafter — I shall choose among them myself.

sentences.zh: 凡有官守不勤於職者，勿問漢人、回回皆論誅之，且沒其家。

translations.literal: Any official who is negligent in his duties, whether Han or Muslim, shall be executed, and his family confiscated."
translations.idiomatic: Any official negligent in his duties, whether Han or Muslim, shall be executed and his family confiscated."

sentences.zh: 」女直、水達達軍不出征者，令隸民籍輸賦。

translations.literal: Female Jurchen and Udege troops who do not go on campaign are ordered to be registered as civilian households and pay taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Female Jurchen and Udege troops who do not go on campaign are ordered to be registered as civilian households and pay taxes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷金州守船軍千人，量留監守，餘皆遣還。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the thousand ship-guard troops at Jin Prefecture were abolished; a measured number kept for supervision, the rest all sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the thousand ship-guard troops at Jin Prefecture were disbanded; a measured number were kept for supervision and the rest sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔行中書省左丞忽辛兼領杭州等路諸色人匠，以杭州稅課所入，歲造繒段十萬以進。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, an edict ordered left censor of the mobile Central Secretariat Husin concurrently to oversee artisans of all categories in Hangzhou and other circuits; from Hangzhou's tax revenue, one hundred thousand bolts of silk were to be manufactured annually for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered mobile Central Secretariat left censor Husin concurrently to oversee artisans of all categories in Hangzhou and other circuits; from Hangzhou tax revenue one hundred thousand bolts of silk were to be manufactured annually for presentation.

sentences.zh: 杭、蘇、嘉興三路辦課官吏，額外多取分例，今後月給食錢，或數外多取者罪之。

translations.literal: Tax-collecting officials of Hangzhou, Suzhou, and Jiaxing circuits took extra commission beyond quota; henceforth they would receive monthly food allowances; those who took more than prescribed would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Tax-collecting officials of Hangzhou, Suzhou, and Jiaxing circuits took extra commission beyond quota; henceforth they would receive monthly food allowances, and those who took more than prescribed would be punished.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬言：「王相府官趙炳雲，陜西課程歲辦萬九千錠，所司若果盡心措辦，可得四萬錠。

translations.literal: Ahmad said: "Prince Anxi's chancellery official Zhao Bing said that Shaanxi tax revenue yields nineteen thousand ingots annually; if the responsible offices truly applied themselves, forty thousand ingots could be obtained."
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad said: "Prince Anxi's chancellery official Zhao Bing said Shaanxi tax revenue yields nineteen thousand ingots annually; if the responsible offices truly applied themselves, forty thousand ingots could be obtained."

sentences.zh: 」即命炳總之。

translations.literal: Zhao Bing was immediately ordered to take overall charge.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bing was immediately ordered to take overall charge.

sentences.zh: 同知揚州總管府事董仲威坐贓罪，行臺方按其事，仲威反誣行臺官以他事。

translations.literal: Associate prefectural commissioner Dong Zhongwei of Yangzhou was guilty of corruption; the regional office was investigating when Zhongwei falsely accused regional officials of other matters.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou associate prefectural commissioner Dong Zhongwei was guilty of corruption; while the regional office was investigating, Zhongwei falsely accused regional officials of other matters.

sentences.zh: 詔免仲威官，仍沒其產十之二。

translations.literal: An edict removed Zhongwei from office and confiscated two-tenths of his property.
translations.idiomatic: An edict removed Zhongwei from office and confiscated two-tenths of his property.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王相府言：「四川宣慰司有籍無軍虛受賞者一萬七千三百八人。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Prince Anxi's chancellery reported: "The Sichuan Pacification Commission has seventeen thousand three hundred eight persons on the rolls without actual military service who falsely received rewards."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Anxi's chancellery reported: "The Sichuan Pacification Commission has 17,308 persons on the rolls without actual military service who falsely received rewards."

sentences.zh: 」命詰治之。

translations.literal: An order was issued to investigate and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to investigate and punish them.

sentences.zh: 議罷漢人之為達魯花赤者。

translations.literal: It was deliberated to abolish Hans serving as darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: It was deliberated to abolish Hans serving as darughachi.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「江南三路管課官，於分例外支用鈔一千九百錠。

translations.literal: Censorate officials reported: "Tax officials of the three Jiangnan circuits spent one thousand nine hundred ingots of notes beyond their allotted commission."
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported: "Tax officials of the three Jiangnan circuits spent 1,900 ingots of notes beyond their allotted commission."

sentences.zh: 」命盡征之。

translations.literal: An order was issued to recover all of it.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to recover all of it.

sentences.zh: 詔遣使招諭西南諸蠻部族酋長，能率所部歸附者，官不失職，民不失業。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to summon and instruct chieftains of southwestern barbarian tribes — those who could lead their followers to submit would keep their offices and their people would not lose their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched envoys to summon and instruct chieftains of southwestern barbarian tribes; those who led their followers to submit would keep their offices and their people would not lose their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以忽必來、別速臺為都元帥，將蒙古軍二千人、河西軍一千人，戍斡端城。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Hubilai and Bessutai were made commander-in-chief, leading two thousand Mongol troops and one thousand Hexi troops to garrison Wandan city.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Hubilai and Bessutai were made commander-in-chief, leading two thousand Mongol troops and one thousand Hexi troops to garrison Wandan city.

sentences.zh: 己巳，樞密院臣言：「有唐兀帶者冒禁引軍千餘人，於辰溪、沅州等處劫掠新附人千餘口及牛馬、金銀、幣帛等，而麻陽縣達魯花赤武伯不花為之鄉導。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Privy Council officials reported: "One Tangudai, in violation of prohibitions, led more than a thousand troops to plunder more than a thousand newly submitted persons plus cattle, horses, gold, silver, and silks at Chenxi, Yuanzhou, and other places; and Mayang County darughachi Wobuhua served as their guide."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Privy Council officials reported: "Tangudai, in violation of prohibitions, led more than a thousand troops to plunder more than a thousand newly submitted persons plus cattle, horses, gold, silver, and silks at Chenxi, Yuanzhou, and other places, while Mayang County darughachi Wobuhua served as their guide."

sentences.zh: 」敕斬唐兀帶、武伯不花，余減死論，以所掠者還其民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Tangudai and Wobuhua beheaded; the rest sentenced to reduced death; plunder was returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Tangudai and Wobuhua beheaded; the rest received reduced death sentences, and plunder was returned to the people.

sentences.zh: 給河西行省鈔萬錠，以備支用。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes were issued to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand ingots of notes were issued to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for expenses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敘州、夔府至江陵界立水驛。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, river relay stations were established from Xuzhou and Kuifu to the Jiangling border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day river relay stations were established from Xuzhou and Kuifu to the Jiangling border.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，帝御香閣。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the emperor attended at the Incense Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the emperor attended at the Incense Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 命大樂署令完顏椿等肄文武樂。

translations.literal: Director of the Grand Music Office Wanyan Chun and others were ordered to rehearse civil and military music.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Music Office director Wanyan Chun and others were ordered to rehearse civil and military music.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張融訴西京軍戶和買和雇，有司匿所給價鈔計萬八千餘錠；

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Zhang Rong complained that in corvée purchases and labor hires for Western Capital military households, the responsible offices concealed price notes totaling more than eighteen thousand ingots;
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhang Rong complained that in corvée purchases and labor hires for Western Capital military households, the responsible offices concealed price notes totaling more than eighteen thousand ingots;

sentences.zh: 官吏坐罪，以融為侍衛軍總把。

translations.literal: the officials were punished; Rong was made zongba of the guard army.
translations.idiomatic: the officials were punished and Rong was made zongba of the guard army.

sentences.zh: 千戶脫略、總把忽帶擅引軍入婺州永康縣界，殺掠吏民，事覺，自陳扈從先帝出征有功，乞貸死。

translations.literal: Qianhu Tuolüe and zongba Hudai unauthorized led troops into Yongkang county of Wuzhou, killing and plundering officials and people; when discovered, they pleaded that they had accompanied the former emperor on campaign with merit and begged commutation of death.
translations.idiomatic: Qianhu Tuolüe and zongba Hudai unauthorized led troops into Yongkang county of Wuzhou, killing and plundering officials and people; when discovered, they pleaded service on campaign with the former emperor and begged commutation of death.

sentences.zh: 敕沒入其家貲之半，杖遣之。

translations.literal: An edict confiscated half their family property and exiled them after beating.
translations.idiomatic: An edict confiscated half their family property and exiled them after beating.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑和州貧民鈔。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, notes were issued to relieve the poor of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day notes were issued to relieve the poor of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，納碧玉爵於太廟。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, a jade-green goblet was deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day a jade-green goblet was deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯太微西垣上將。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the moon transgressed the western rampart general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the western rampart general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以月直元辰，命五祖真人李居壽作醮事，奏赤章，凡五晝夜。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, because the month aligned with his personal fortune day, the Five Patriarchs Perfect Man Li Jushou was ordered to perform a jiao rite and submit a red memorial — five day-nights in all.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the month aligned with his personal fortune day, Five Patriarchs Perfect Man Li Jushou was ordered to perform a jiao rite and submit a red memorial for five day-nights.

sentences.zh: 畢事，居壽請間言：「皇太子春秋鼎盛，宜預國政。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, Jushou requested a private audience and said: "The crown prince is in the prime of youth — he should participate in state affairs."
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, Jushou requested a private audience and said: "The crown prince is in the prime of youth — he should participate in state affairs."

sentences.zh: 」帝喜曰：「尋將及之。

translations.literal: The emperor said with pleasure: "That will come soon."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said with pleasure: "That will come soon."

sentences.zh: 」明日，下詔皇太子燕王參決朝政，凡中書省、樞密院、御史臺及百司之事，皆先啟後聞。

translations.literal: The next day, an edict was issued that Crown Prince Prince of Yan would participate in deciding court affairs; all matters of the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and the hundred offices were to be reported to him first, then to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The next day an edict ordered Crown Prince Prince of Yan to participate in deciding court affairs; all matters of the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and the hundred offices were to be reported to him first, then to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜高麗國王至元十七年曆日。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the King of Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan seventeenth-year calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the King of Goryeo received the Zhiyuan seventeenth-year calendar.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，敕諸路所捕盜，初犯贓多者死，再犯贓少者從輕罪論。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wushen day: an edict — robbers captured on various routes: first offense with large booty — death; second offense with small booty — lighter punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wushen day: an edict ordered that robbers captured on various routes — first offense with large booty — die; second offense with small booty — receive lighter punishment.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬言：「有盜以舊鈔易官庫新鈔百四十錠者，議者謂罪不應死，且盜者之父執役臣家，不論如法，寧不自畏。

translations.literal: Ahmad said: "There was a thief who exchanged old notes for one hundred forty ingots of new notes from the government treasury; deliberators said the crime should not warrant death — yet the thief's father serves in my household; if not punished according to law, how would he not fear?"
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad said: "There was a thief who exchanged old notes for one hundred forty ingots of new notes from the government treasury; deliberators said the crime should not warrant death — yet the thief's father serves in my household; if not punished according to law, how would he not fear?"

sentences.zh: 」詔處死。

translations.literal: An edict ordered execution.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered execution.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣禮部尚書柴椿偕安南國使村中贊賫詔往諭安南國世子陳日烜，責其來朝。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Minister of Rites Chai Chun was sent together with Annam envoy Trung Nhan to bear an edict instructing Annam heir Chen Nhat Hoang and demanding he come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Minister of Rites Chai Chun was sent with Annam envoy Trung Nhan to bear an edict instructing Annam heir Chen Nhat Hoang and demanding he come to court.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷太原、平陽、西京、延安路新簽軍還籍。

translations.literal: On yimao day, newly enlisted troops of Taiyuan, Pingyang, Western Capital, and Yan'an circuits were disbanded and returned to their registers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day newly enlisted troops of Taiyuan, Pingyang, Western Capital, and Yan'an circuits were disbanded and returned to their registers.

sentences.zh: 罷招討使劉萬奴所管無籍軍願從大軍征討者。

translations.literal: The unregistered troops under pacification commissioner Liu Wannu who wished to follow the main army on campaign were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: The unregistered troops under pacification commissioner Liu Wannu who wished to follow the main army on campaign were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 趙炳言陜西運司郭同知、王相府郎中令郭叔雲盜用官錢，敕尚書禿速忽、侍御史郭祐檢核之。

translations.literal: Zhao Bing reported that Shaanxi Transport Commission associate commissioner Guo and Prince Anxi's chancellery bureau director Guo Shuyun misappropriated government funds; an edict ordered Minister Toutuhu and supervising censor Guo You to inspect and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bing reported that Shaanxi Transport Commission associate commissioner Guo and Prince Anxi's chancellery bureau director Guo Shuyun misappropriated government funds; an edict ordered Minister Toutuhu and supervising censor Guo You to inspect and verify.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命湖北道宣慰使劉深教練鄂州、漢陽新附水軍。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Hubei Circuit pacification commissioner Liu Shen was ordered to drill the newly submitted naval forces of Ezhou and Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Hubei Circuit pacification commissioner Liu Shen was ordered to drill the newly submitted naval forces of Ezhou and Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 詔諭四川宣慰司括軍民戶數。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the Sichuan Pacification Commission to register military and civilian household counts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Sichuan Pacification Commission to register military and civilian household counts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以梧州妖民吳法受扇惑藤州、德慶府瀧水徭蠻為亂，獲其父，誅之。

translations.literal: On jisi day, because Wuzhou sorcerer Wu Fashou incited the Longshui Yao barbarians of Teng Prefecture and Deqing Prefecture to rebel, his father was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, because Wuzhou sorcerer Wu Fashou incited the Longshui Yao barbarians of Teng Prefecture and Deqing Prefecture to rebel, his father was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 並教坊司入拱衛司。

translations.literal: The Music Bureau was merged into the Palace Guard Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Bureau was merged into the Palace Guard Bureau.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，發粟鈔賑鹽司竈戶之貧者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuyin day: grain and notes were issued to relieve poor salt-works households.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuyin day: grain and notes were issued to relieve poor salt-works households.

sentences.zh: 括甘州戶。

translations.literal: Ganzhou households were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou households were registered.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，安南國貢藥材。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Annam presented tribute of medicinal materials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Annam presented medicinal materials as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祀太陽。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the sun was worshipped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the sun was worshipped.

sentences.zh: 丙申，敕樞密、翰林院官，就中書省與唆都議招收海外諸番事。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, an edict ordered Privy Council and Hanlin Academy officials to join the Central Secretariat in deliberating with Suodu on attracting and submitting the various overseas fan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered Privy Council and Hanlin Academy officials to join the Central Secretariat in deliberating with Suodu on attracting and submitting the various overseas fan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，八里灰貢海青。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Baligai presented tribute of sea hawks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Baligai presented sea hawks as tribute.

sentences.zh: 回回等所過供食，羊非自殺者不食，百姓苦之。

translations.literal: Muslims and others, when passing through, had food supplied; they would not eat sheep unless self-slaughtered — the people suffered from this.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims and others, when passing through, had food supplied but would not eat sheep unless self-slaughtered — the people suffered from this.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「彼吾奴也，飲食敢不隨我朝乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "They are my slaves — how dare their diet not follow our dynasty's ways?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "They are my slaves — how dare their diet not follow our dynasty's ways?"

sentences.zh: 」詔禁之。

translations.literal: An edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade it.

sentences.zh: 詔諭海內海外諸番國主。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the rulers of various fan countries within and beyond the seas.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the rulers of various fan countries within and beyond the seas.

sentences.zh: 賜右丞張惠銀五千四百兩。

translations.literal: Right censor Zhang Hui was granted five thousand four hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Right censor Zhang Hui received five thousand four hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 敕自明年正月朔日，建醮於長春宮，凡七日，歲以為例。

translations.literal: An edict: from the first day of the first month next year, jiao rites were to be established at Changchun Palace for seven days — to be made an annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from the first day of the first month next year jiao rites be established at Changchun Palace for seven days, to be made an annual precedent.

sentences.zh: 命李居壽告祭新歲。

translations.literal: Li Jushou was ordered to announce and sacrifice for the new year.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jushou was ordered to announce and sacrifice for the new year.

sentences.zh: 詔諭占城國主，使親自來朝。

translations.literal: An edict addressed the king of Champa, ordering him to come to court in person.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the king of Champa to come to court in person.

sentences.zh: 唆都所遣阇婆國使臣治中趙玉還。

translations.literal: Zhao Yu, associate administrator and envoy of Java whom Sudu had dispatched, returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yu, the Java envoy of associate administrator rank whom Sudu had dispatched, returned.

sentences.zh: 改單州、兗州隸濟寧路；

translations.literal: Shan Prefecture and Yan Prefecture were placed under Jining Route;
translations.idiomatic: Shan Prefecture and Yan Prefecture were placed under Jining Route;

sentences.zh: 復置萬泉縣，隸河中府；

translations.literal: Wanquan County was restored and placed under Hezhong Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Wanquan County was restored and placed under Hezhong Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 改垣曲縣隸絳州；

translations.literal: Yuanqu County was transferred to Jiang Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqu County was transferred to Jiang Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 降歸州路為州；

translations.literal: Guizhou Route was demoted to a prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Route was demoted to a prefecture;

sentences.zh: 升沔陽、安陸各為府；

translations.literal: Mianyang and Anlu were each promoted to fu;
translations.idiomatic: Mianyang and Anlu were each promoted to fu;

sentences.zh: 改京兆為安西路；

translations.literal: Jingzhao was changed to Anxi Route;
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao was changed to Anxi Route;

sentences.zh: 改惠州、建寧、梧州、柳州、象州、邕州、慶遠、賓州、橫州、容州、潯州並為路。

translations.literal: Huizhou, Jianning, Wuzhou, Liuzhou, Xiangzhou, Yongzhou, Qingyuan, Binzhou, Hengzhou, Rongzhou, and Xunzhou were all changed to routes.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou, Jianning, Wuzhou, Liuzhou, Xiangzhou, Yongzhou, Qingyuan, Binzhou, Hengzhou, Rongzhou, and Xunzhou were all promoted to routes.

sentences.zh: 建聖壽萬安寺於京城。

translations.literal: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built in the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝師亦憐吉卒。

translations.literal: Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa died.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa died.

sentences.zh: 敕諸國教師禪師百有八人，即大都萬安寺設齋圓戒，賜衣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered one hundred eight teachers and chan masters from all states to hold a feast and complete precepts ceremony at the Great Capital's Wan'an Temple, and granted them robes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered one hundred eight teachers and chan masters from all countries to hold a feast and full precept ceremony at Wan'an Temple in the great capital, and granted them robes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，斷死罪百三十二人。

translations.literal: That year one hundred thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year one hundred thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 保定等二十餘路水旱風雹害稼。

translations.literal: In more than twenty routes including Baoding, flood, drought, wind, and hail damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding and more than twenty other routes suffered flood, drought, wind, and hail damage to crops.
